title: Campaign Director
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Campaign Director em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Duration: 1 year

Employment type: Independent contractor agreement

Location: Anywhere. Working hours must overlap at least 4 hours with GMT timezone

Reporting to: Senior Director

Salary: Approx. USD $50,000 depending on location

Application closing date: June 1st 9am BST


How to apply

Do not apply through LinkedIn. Please apply by answering the role-specific questions which can be found here (

About the Secure Energy Project

The Secure Energy Project (SEP) is a communications initiative that exists to build unstoppable support for a global shift to clean energy. We identify the obstacles slowing progress, then work with partners to design and run collaborative campaigns that remove them. We bring together allies across civil society, policy and industry to influence the narrative and politics of energy.


The transition to clean energy can improve everything: lower bills, better jobs, cleaner air and more connected communities. Yet progress is still too slow and increasingly vulnerable to misinformation and political backlash.


Now entering our third year, SEP is leading global communications efforts, coordinating campaign coalitions, and launching audience-led interventions in key countries. We're helping the climate movement fight smarter, faster, and together.


Who we’re looking for

We’re looking for a Campaign Director to help tell a bigger, bolder story about the energy transition - inspiring people to see clean energy as the foundation for healthier lives, stronger communities and greater security.


You’ll help shift how people think and talk about energy by building communications that reach beyond the usual audiences. You’ll work with influencers, community voices, experts and unexpected allies to make clean energy feel practical, popular and urgent.


To change everything, it takes everyone. That’s why you’ll help SEP play a leading role in networks that bring together hundreds of organisations working towards the same goal. You’ll spot opportunities for collaboration, support the leadership of others and help turn shared ambition into joint projects that are more than the sum of their parts.


Working closely with the Senior Director, you’ll deliver news-driven, cutting-edge communications, support rapid-response work and coordinate with partners across our global network to share intelligence, test ideas and collaborate on high-impact interventions in public and political debates.

This role is ideal for a strong communicator or campaigner who is both strategic and hands-on. You can translate big-picture strategy into compelling content, build trusted relationships with collaborators and move quickly when opportunities arise.


We’re looking for someone who is ahead of the curve on communications and campaigns. You understand that speeding up the shift to clean energy means breaking out of echo chambers, building alliances with new audiences and unlikely partners, and shaping news agendas in real time with digital-first, innovative tactics. You’ll bring both the patience to take people with you and the punchiness to help shift the movement into a different gear.


What you’ll do Drive narrative change on energy transition

  • Work closely with the Senior Director to deliver SEP’s communications campaigns.
  • Design innovative strategies, materials and interventions for major moments in the clean energy calendar, including summits, geopolitical events, campaign launches and report releases.
  • Translate audience insights, polling and political analysis into strategic communications outputs tailored to specific audiences.
  • Turn campaign strategy into creative ideas and interventions that can shift how people think and talk about energy.
  • Help strengthen the wider clean energy movement by supporting the day-to-day coordination of SEP’s global networks and coalitions.
  • Plan and run meetings, workshops and follow-up processes that encourage lively communication, practical collaboration and shared delivery.
  • Build clear workplans, outputs and timelines to support delivery across multiple fast-moving projects.
  • Track progress and keep partners and donors up to speed on what’s working, what’s not, and what that means for our collective impact.


Narrative monitoring and rapid response coordination 

  • Spot the moments that matter - tracking media, politics and digital conversations to identify where clean energy narratives can be advanced, defended or reframed.
  • Coordinate partners across SEP’s coalitions so the right voices are ready to speak out quickly, confidently and effectively.
  • Produce rapid-response materials, including key messages, talking points, media pitches, briefing notes and digital content.
  • Help SEP and its partners prepare for major events, risks and opportunities with clear plans, strong narratives and timely interventions.


Media pitching and spokesperson training 

  • Support media outreach by drafting pitches, building targeted media lists, maintaining journalist relationships and proactively spotting opportunities to place clean energy stories and spokespeople.
  • Identify strong spokespeople from across the clean energy NGO community and help prepare them for media interviews through messaging guidance, briefing materials and training opportunities.
  • Build a broader, more diverse network of trusted voices for clean energy - including farmers, workers, community organisers, clean tech entrepreneurs, local leaders and others who can speak credibly to their own communities.
  • Work with the Senior Director and other Communications Directors to activate spokespeople across traditional media and strategic online spaces.


Strategic support and special projects

  • Support the Senior Director with the design and delivery of new or evolving priority projects, ie. with our existing campaign to promote the benefits of solar power in Nigeria, or a cross-country campaign we’re developing to turbocharge electrification in the lead-up to COP31. 
  • Assist in drafting materials for fundraising proposals and donor communications.


About you:

  • You have a hunger to change the world, and are willing to take risks to change it. 
  • You think innovatively about communications and campaigns - you enjoy experimenting with new and outside-the-box approaches.
  • You can influence people - you understand what makes people tick and how to get them on-side. 
  • You think strategically and you can also get things done. 
  • You’re extremely organised and you like keeping other people organised too. 
  • You're proactive - you don’t wait around to be asked to do something, you take the initiative and crack on. 
  • You don’t shy away from picking up the phone to strangers or chasing people who are ignoring your emails. 
  • You are confident enough to ask 'why?', to question the judgement of those more senior than you, and to admit when you’ve made mistakes. 
  • You have a good sense of humour, you don’t take yourself too seriously and you have excellent people management skills.
  • You are comfortable working in an organisation guided by feminist values and have zero tolerance for misogyny, racism and bullying.  


Essential skills and experience

  • 5+ years of experience in a communications, campaigns or media role. Does not have to be within the NGO sector.
  • A creative mindset and strong interest in using storytelling and digital campaigning to drive change.
  • Experience supporting or delivering communications campaigns. 
  • Strong writing and editing skills, with a track record for producing impactful media and digital content.
  • Experience pitching to the media, drafting press releases and media briefings, and identifying and supporting spokespeople to deliver messages effectively. 
  • Good understanding of energy and climate issues, or proven ability to quickly build subject knowledge.
  • Experience working across teams, organisations, and geographies.
  • Highly organised, proactive, and comfortable working in a fast-paced, remote environment.
  • Excellent English. Fluent Spanish would be a bonus, but it’s not essential. 


What we offer

  • A chance to produce communications work that accelerates the transition to clean and affordable energy and changes the world in the process.
  • The opportunity to get in on the ground floor of a small, high-ambition feminist start-up with a growing reputation.
  • A collaborative, flexible, values-driven team with space to test and learn.
  • Flexible working conditions, because childcare or other caring responsibilities are not hobbies.
  • Opportunities to work across borders with partners and change-makers in climate and energy.
  • Competitive compensation. Approx. USD $50,000 depending on location and experience.


How to apply

Do not apply through LinkedIn. Please apply by answering the role-specific questions which can be found here (

  • Deadline June 1st 9am BST

title: Technical Project Manager
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Technical Project Manager em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

This is a fully remote position, PJ contract and salary range is 28-35/hr USD.


Required Skills & Experience


• 5+ years in Technical Program Management, Program Management, or Delivery/Project Leadership in software/product environments.

• Strong experience working with engineering teams (front-end, back-end, APIs, integrations) and translating requirements into execution plans.

• Demonstrated ability to manage multiple parallel workstreams with dependencies, ambiguity, and shifting priorities.

• Comfort operating in Agile delivery environments and facilitating common delivery ceremonies.

• Strong ability to communicate clearly with technical and non-technical stakeholders—written, verbal, and executive-ready status reporting.

• Proven organizational skills: structured thinking, attention to detail, follow-through, and accountability.


Nice to Have Skills & Experience


• CPG experience (Consumer Packaged Goods) or work supporting enterprise-scale commerce, marketing, or customer platforms.

• Experience using GitHub for product/engineering workflows (issues, epics, project boards, milestones, release tracking).

• AI workflow experience (automation, copilots/assistants, orchestration tools, or applied AI to improve delivery ops).

• Experience supporting digital commerce capabilities (e.g., customer experience, product catalogs, order flows, promotions, personalization, content, analytics).

• Familiarity with Elixir and/or React environments—enough to partner effectively with engineers, understand constraints, and anticipate delivery risks.


Job Description


The Digital Commerce team is seeking a Technical Program Manager (TPM) to amplify product delivery and relieve a Product Manager who is currently balancing product discovery alongside multiple concurrent projects. This TPM will drive program execution across cross-functional teams—translating product intent into clear plans, predictable delivery, and measurable outcomes—while ensuring work is well-managed in GitHub (where our PM workflows now live). This role is ideal for someone who thrives at the intersection of product, engineering, and operations—bringing structure, visibility, and momentum to complex initiatives, and enabling the PM to focus on customer and market discovery.

• Own end-to-end program management for multiple digital commerce initiatives, from intake through delivery and rollout.

• Build and maintain integrated plans (milestones, dependencies, risks, resourcing, timeline) across product, engineering, data, QA, security, and partner teams.

• Drive delivery rituals: standups, sprint/iteration planning support, backlog readiness, dependency reviews, status reporting, and go/no-go readiness.

• Serve as the connective tissue between Product, Engineering, and business stakeholders—ensuring alignment on scope, sequencing, tradeoffs, and “definition of done.”

• Proactively manage dependencies, risks, and decisions; escalate with context and options, not just problems.

• Ensure clear communication across teams and leadership with concise updates and action-oriented readouts.

• Help standardize how initiatives are tracked in GitHub (e.g., issues, epics, project boards, milestones), driving consistent hygiene and visibility.

• Improve team throughput by reducing friction in processes and tooling (templates, workflows, reporting, intake). • Identify opportunities to use AI-enabled workflows to reduce overhead (e.g., release comms drafting, backlog grooming support, automated status summaries, incident triage workflows, documentation acceleration) while maintaining governance and quality.

• Partner with engineering and product to implement pragmatic automation that improves delivery efficiency.

• Coordinate release plans across teams: readiness checklists, rollout sequencing, communication plans, training/support readiness, and post-launch monitoring.

• Ensure operational handoffs and documentation are complete for production support.

title: Java Software Engineer
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Java Software Engineer em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Company Description

Theta Data is a pioneering data company specializing in low-latency APIs for delivering high-speed options and stocks data. Our mission is to empower users with real-time, actionable information to make well-informed decisions in dynamic financial markets. With a focus on speed and broad data coverage, Theta Data stands at the forefront of the options data industry by providing essential tools and insights. We are dedicated to equipping professionals with the resources needed to excel in a competitive landscape.


We’re a small, nimble team growing quickly. Our platform handles billions of database requests daily, and we’re just getting started. The complexity of our data problems is real: tick-level options data is among the most intricate financial data to store, index, and serve at scale. We take engineering seriously.


Role Description

We’re hiring backend-focused Software Engineers to help build and scale the services that power Theta Data. This is a hands-on coding role. You’ll be writing production code from day one. We are looking for self-starting engineers who think deeply about system scale, creatively solve problems, and can move forward in high ambiguity.


You’ll join a lean engineering team where your work has a direct, visible impact on the platform and the customers who use it. We have new services to architect, bottlenecks to eliminate, and workflows to redesign from scratch.


Additionally, you’ll support live systems, investigate and resolve bugs, and help keep a platform that customers depend on running smoothly.


What you will work on

  • Design, build, and scale backend services handling billions of requests daily
  • Architect new systems and contribute to technical direction
  • Improve and automate customer onboarding workflows
  • Identify and resolve performance bottlenecks across the stack
  • Collaborate directly with the team and senior technical leadership


Our Technical Stack

  • Java - core backend services, business logic, API, thick client
  • Python - scripting, tooling
  • Apache Tomcat - servlet container
  • Java Servlets - HTTP request handling
  • PostgreSQL + Hibernate
  • gRPC
  • AI coding tools (Claude, Gemini, Copilot) - we use them, you should too


What we are looking for

We hire for fundamentals, ownership, and a love of building. Depending on your experience level, here’s what we care about:


Required

  • Deep proficiency in Java with a strong command of the language and ecosystem
  • Proven experience optimizing application performance through JVM heap tuning, garbage collection analysis, and memory allocation strategies
  • Strong computer science fundamentals, including data structures, algorithms, and systems-level thinking
  • Demonstrated experience designing, building, and maintaining REST APIs and backend services
  • Working knowledge of HTTP, authentication protocols, and modern web architecture


Nice to Have

  • Experience working in data-intensive, low-latency environments where performance matters
  • Hands-on experience with PostgreSQL, including schema design and query optimization
  • Python development experience for tooling, scripting, or service work
  • Familiarity with Apache Tomcat in production or staging environments
  • Frontend exposure with TypeScript and a modern UI library or framework (Vue, React, or similar)
  • Experience designing or maintaining CI/CD pipelines for automated build, test, and deployment


Why Theta Data

  • Rapid growth: the platform and team are both scaling fast
  • Real engineering challenges: data at scale, low-latency systems, complex financial data
  • High ownership: a small team means your decisions matter and ship quickly
  • Greenfield opportunities: new systems to design, not just legacy to maintain
  • Remote-first: work from anywhere
  • Direct impact: your work reaches thousands of quants and researchers daily

title: HNW Client Manager
description:

Remote | Athens HQ support Independent Contractor Uncapped commission with strong earning potential for top performers

Who We Are

Ambitious people deserve options regardless of where they were born.

PassBeyond helps high-net-worth individuals secure residency and citizenship through investment. Our clients invest €250,000–€800,000+ and receive residency or citizenship for themselves and their families — gaining Schengen access, international asset diversification, and long-term optionality.

Founded by Andreas Afeldt, who is based full-time in Athens and has spent over a decade working with high-net-worth clients across international markets. PassBeyond sits between global institutional scale and personal, founder-led trust — with deep local knowledge in Greece and cultural fluency across every market we serve.

We're looking for a Relationship Manager to serve clients from your network.

This is not a traditional sales role. We're looking for someone who already moves in the same circles as successful entrepreneurs, business owners, and senior professionals — and who can introduce them to an opportunity that provides real security and optionality for their families.

You will:

  • Introduce PassBeyond to high-net-worth individuals in your network
  • Help clients understand the real numbers, real timelines, and real risks — so they can make an informed decision
  • Guide clients from first conversation through to permit in hand
  • Build trust through genuine conversation — not scripts or pressure tactics
  • Work remotely with full support from our Athens headquarters

We're not looking for cold-callers. We're looking for trusted advisors.

Who Our Clients Are

  • Entrepreneurs, business owners, and investors with €250,000–€800,000+ to invest
  • Successful individuals who have built or grown significant wealth
  • Discerning clients who value due diligence and take time to make important decisions
  • Looking for optionality: security, Schengen access, European education, and peace of mind for their families
  • They value relationships over transactions and won't be rushed or pressured

Our clients need someone who understands their world, respects their care in decision-making, and guides with patience and honesty.

Essential:

  • Existing relationships with high-net-worth individuals
  • Cultural fluency - you genuinely understand the communities you'd serve
  • Professional working proficiency in English (written and verbal)
  • Comfortable with performance-based compensation
  • Integrity - you'd rather lose a deal than mislead someone

Highly Desirable:

  • Experience in real estate, immigration, wealth management, or financial services

Backgrounds that often do well:

  • Business owners and entrepreneurs
  • Private bankers and wealth managers
  • Lawyers and accountants serving affluent clients
  • Real estate professionals in investment or luxury markets
  • Community leaders and well-connected professionals

What You Get

  • Full training and certification on our programmes — no cost to you
  • Access to our curated property portfolio (60+ vetted developments across Athens)

  • Deep experience with VMware vCenter and vSphere — including ESXi administration, vMotion, HA/DRS, distributed virtual switches, and VM lifecycle management.
  • Deep experience with Citrix Virtual Apps and Desktops (CVAD) or Citrix DaaS — including Delivery Controllers, StoreFront, NetScaler/ADC, machine catalogs, and VDA troubleshooting.

title: FX Trader
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para FX Trader em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Role Overview

We are seeking a highly skilled Emerging Markets FX Trader with deep expertise in African and/or Latin American currencies to join our global trading & liquidity team. The ideal candidate will have extensive experience managing illiquid and restricted FX markets, executing OTC and interbank trades, and designing robust hedging and liquidity frameworks to support high-volume cross-border payment flows. This role requires both strong trading capability and infrastructure expertise, including building and optimizing FX trading systems, hedging engines, and liquidity connectivity with banks, brokers, and OTC counterparties.



Key Responsibilities

FX Trading & Liquidity Management

  • Manage proprietary and flow-driven FX trading positions across Emerging Market currencies , with a focus on African (e.g., NGN, KES, ZAR, GHS) or LATAM (e.g., BRL, MXN, COP, ARS) markets.
  • Source and maintain deep liquidity relationships with banks, brokers, and OTC desks across relevant regions.
  • Execute spot, forwards, NDFs, swaps, and OTC trades to optimize execution quality and manage currency exposure.
  • Monitor market developments, capital controls, and liquidity dynamics across EM FX markets.


Hedging Strategy & Risk Management

  • Design and implement FX hedging strategies to manage corporate or client-driven exposures.
  • Optimize hedging efficiency across multiple liquidity venues including banks, ECNs, OTC desks, and crypto liquidity pools where relevant.
  • Develop models for dynamic hedging, inventory risk management, and spread optimization .
  • Monitor risk limits, PnL, and exposure across currency books.


Trading Infrastructure & Systems

  • Work closely with engineering and product teams to build and enhance FX trading and hedging infrastructure , including:
  • Automated hedging engines
  • Liquidity aggregation systems
  • Smart order routing
  • Pricing and risk management tools
  • Integrate connectivity with banks, ECNs, and liquidity providers via APIs or FIX protocols.
  • Improve execution automation, latency optimization, and real-time exposure monitoring .


Market Development

  • Identify and onboard new liquidity providers and OTC trading partners across emerging markets.
  • Build pricing frameworks for illiquid currency pairs and support new corridor launches.
  • Contribute to the development of scalable FX infrastructure supporting global payments and settlement flows.



Requirements

Experience

  • 5–10+ years of FX trading experience in Emerging Markets.
  • Strong experience trading African or LATAM currencies , such as:
  • Africa: NGN, KES, ZAR, GHS, EGP
  • LATAM: BRL, MXN, COP, CLP, ARS
  • Experience working at:
  • Global banks
  • EM FX trading firms
  • Payment / fintech companies
  • Crypto exchanges or market makers
  • Proven experience executing OTC and institutional-sized FX trades .


Technical Expertise

  • Deep understanding of:
  • FX market microstructure in illiquid markets
  • NDF markets and offshore hedging
  • Capital controls and FX regulatory frameworks
  • Hands-on experience building or optimizing:
  • FX trading systems
  • Hedging engines
  • Liquidity aggregation platforms
  • Familiarity with FIX connectivity, API-based trading systems, and algorithmic execution .


Skills

  • Strong quantitative and analytical capabilities.
  • Ability to operate in high-volatility and fragmented liquidity environments .
  • Strong network within EM FX liquidity providers and OTC trading desks .
  • Excellent communication and cross-functional collaboration skills.


Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience supporting high-volume cross-border payment flows or treasury operations .
  • Experience trading EM FX through both traditional banks and alternative liquidity sources .
  • Familiarity with stablecoin / crypto liquidity markets in emerging economies .
  • Background in building or scaling FX market-making operations .
  • Strong analytical and problem solving skills
  • Ability to operate across global teams and fast paced environments



Vision & Mission

  • OSL is the first SFC-licensed digital asset platform in Hong Kong and a PayFi innovator. Through stablecoin payments, cross-border settlement and global licensing, we are building the next-generation payments network. Stablecoins have become everyday money across emerging markets and are widely viewed as blockchain’s “killer app,” with industry focus shifting from token issuance to real-world consumer and enterprise payment adoption. The strongest growth lies in cross-border B2B payments, where providers embedding stablecoins into corporate settlement flows can capture significant volume and float. Long-term defensibility comes from regulatory licences, banking partners and cross-border corridors.
  • OSL holds or has acquired licences in Hong Kong, Japan, Australia, Bermuda and Indonesia, and is expanding into Europe, Brazil, Southeast Asia and Africa through acquisitions and licence applications. With OSL Pay and StableX, we embed stablecoin settlement into bank accounts and card networks, support 150+ digital assets, and provide 24/7 fiat–stablecoin conversion. As a regulated pioneer with a startup mindset, we believe the future of payments will be driven by real adoption and scalable deployment, not technology narratives. We welcome builders who are passionate about crypto and payments to join us in shaping compliant, global payment infrastructure.

title: Especialista Técnico SAP I
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Especialista Técnico SAP I em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

No Grupo SBF, reunimos duas grandes forças do esporte no Brasil: a Centauro, maior varejista esportiva multimarcas da América Latina, e a Fisia, distribuidora oficial da Nike no país.


Queremos ser referência em esporte no Brasil e construir um futuro em que cada experiência com o esporte inspire, motive e transforme.


E aí, que tal vestir essa camisa com a gente?


Responsabilidades e atribuições


  • Arquitetura e Governança de Soluções (Keep the Core Clean): Atuar como autoridade técnica e ponto focal para decisões de design em ambientes ABAP e SAP BTP. Garantir a integridade do sistema através da estratégia Keep the Core Clean, definindo padrões de arquitetura (In-app e Side-by-side) que assegurem a escalabilidade e a facilidade de futuras atualizações do ERP.
  • Liderança Técnica e Excelência em Engenharia : Liderar a squad técnica estabelecendo e zelando por padrões de alta performance, segurança e qualidade de código (Clean ABAP). Realizar Code Reviews críticos e auditorias técnicas para garantir que as entregas do time (interno ou terceirizado) estejam alinhadas às melhores práticas de desenvolvimento.
  • Inovação e Modernização do Ecossistema : Direcionar a adoção de tecnologias de ponta e novos modelos de programação, como SAP Fiori, RAP (Restful ABAP Programming Model) e CAP (Cloud Application Programming Model). Identificar oportunidades de inovação tecnológica que transformem processos de negócio em soluções digitais eficientes.
  • Interface Estratégica e Tradução de Negócio : Atuar como facilitador entre as áreas funcionais, Gerentes de Projetos e o time técnico. Traduzir requisitos de negócio complexos em especificações técnicas viáveis, garantindo que as expectativas dos stakeholders sejam atendidas com soluções tecnicamente sustentáveis.
  • Gestão do Ciclo de Vida e Mentoria : Supervisionar o ciclo de vida completo das soluções (do desenho técnico ao deploy e sustentação). Atuar como mentor técnico da equipe, promovendo a disseminação de conhecimento, resolvendo gargalos complexos e elevando o nível de senioridade técnica do time.
  • Ambiente Tecnológico e Desafio: Atuar em um ecossistema (Híbrido / Cloud) de alta criticidade, sendo o guardião da transição tecnológica de legados ABAP para modelos modernos no SAP S/4HANA. O escopo abrange desde o refinamento técnico de melhorias contínuas até a liderança técnica em projetos estruturantes de inovação e integração via SAP BTP.
  • Funcionais e Negócio : Parceria direta com consultores funcionais (MM, SD, FI, CO, etc.) e BPs para traduzir dores operacionais em arquiteturas técnicas robustas.
  • Desenvolvimentos e Projetos: Interface com Gerentes de Projeto e Funcionais para definição de cronogramas técnicos, estimativas de esforço e priorização de backlogs baseada em viabilidade e impacto.
  • Metas Estratégicas do Cargo : Modernização do Core: Atingir KPIs de redução de customizações \"Z\" tradicionais em favor de extensões Side-by-Side e otimização do consumo de serviços no SAP BTP para evitar custos excedentes.
  • Qualidade e Estabilidade : Redução do Lead Time de desenvolvimento e diminuição de incidentes em PRD causados por falhas de transporte ou performance.
  • Nível de Maturidade Técnica : Elevar a proficiência do time em tecnologias como RAP, CAP e Fiori através de programas de mentoria interna.


Requisitos e qualificações


  • Ecossistema SAP: Experiência sólida e comprovada em projetos de alta complexidade, com protagonismo técnico. Domínio prático na arquitetura de extensibilidade via SAP BTP e integrações nativas em nuvem.
  • Domínio de Desenvolvimento Moderno: Vivência profunda em programação ABAP (Standard e OO) em versões 7.5+; Utilização do Eclipse (ADT) e CDS Views.
  • Experiência com Extensibilidade e Cloud: Experiência prática na construção de extensões e integrações utilizando SAP BTP (Business Technology Platform).
  • Histórico de Liderança Técnica: Experiência prévia atuando como referência técnica (Tech Lead), sendo responsável por arquitetura de software, revisão de código (Code Review) e mentoria de desenvolvedores menos experientes.
  • Vivência em Metodologias Ágeis: Experiência de atuação em ambientes dinâmicos utilizando Scrum ou Kanban.

A Teladoc Health, líder global em saúde digital e inovação em cuidados de saúde, está buscando Médicas e Médicos Especialistas em Endocrinologia! Se você é um profissional comprometido com a excelência no atendimento ao paciente e deseja fazer parte de uma revolução na prestação de serviços de saúde, esta é a oportunidade que você estava esperando.


*SOBRE A TELADOC HEALTH: *


A Teladoc Health está na vanguarda da transformação da saúde, oferecendo acesso rápido, conveniente e confiável a serviços de saúde através de nossa plataforma digital. Nossa missão é tornar o cuidado de saúde acessível a todos, em qualquer lugar e a qualquer momento. Combinando tecnologia de ponta e conhecimento médico, estamos moldando o futuro da saúde e proporcionando impacto positivo na vida de milhões de pessoas.


*O QUE PROCURAMOS: *


Você será responsável por realizar consultas por vídeo e telefone, por intermédio de plataforma do empregador, atendendo na modalidade de consultas de especialidade em Endocrinologia , de forma ética, com abordagem biopsicossocial do processo saúde-adoecimento, integrando ações de prevenção, promoção, proteção, recuperação e educação em saúde buscando alcançar os melhores resultados clínicos;


DESCRIÇÃO DAS ATIVIDADES:



  • Fornecer atendimento médico especializado em Endocrinologia de forma remota, através de consultas e avaliações realizadas por meio de plataformas digitais de comunicação.


  • Experiência e conhecimento para o diagnóstico, tratamento e acompanhamento de pacientes com doenças e distúrbios Endocrinológicos .


  • Realizar consultas em Telemedicina sendo capaz de conduzir anamnese virtual para coletar queixas e histórico médico, realizar exame clínico e avaliações à distância, interpretar resultados de exames laboratoriais e de imagem, elaborar diagnósticos precisos, propor medidas terapêuticas e orientações de cuidado, reconhecer sinais de risco e gravidade em Endocrinologia e critérios para encaminhar ao atendimento presencial.


  • Atuar de forma a priorizar a prática médica centrada na pessoa.


  • Elaborar planos de tratamento individualizados, levando em consideração as necessidades específicas de cada paciente.


  • Ser hábil na prescrição de medicamentos adequados para tratar doenças Endocrinológicas .


  • Monitorar o progresso dos pacientes ao longo do tratamento em telemedicina.


  • Realizar ajustes no plano de tratamento, conforme necessário, com base na resposta do paciente ao tratamento.


  • Desenvolver atividades integrais de saúde, incorporando prevenção e promoção de saúde para dar as respostas mais adequadas às necessidades de saúde apresentadas.


  • Atender com elevado grau de qualidade, sendo resolutivo na grande maioria das orientações acerca dos principais problemas de saúde em Endocrinologia.


  • Considerar os valores e preferências pessoais do paciente conjuntamente às melhores evidências científicas e à experiência de manejo clínico para efetivamente promover a melhor prática clínica e os melhores desfechos em saúde para cada indivíduo.


  • Exercer uso racional de recursos em saúde visando a segurança do paciente e a prevenção quaternária, evitando sobrediagnóstico e sobretratamento, que expõe os indivíduos a maiores riscos do que benefícios em saúde.


  • Estimular a participação e a autonomia dos indivíduos e familiares, fortalecendo a aderência a tratamentos e medidas de autocuidado.


  • Documentar todas as interações e informações relevantes dos pacientes em prontuários eletrônicos seguros e confidenciais.


  • Ter capacidade de crítica de sua própria atividade médica, considerando-a em seus aspectos científicos, éticos e sociais para aprimoramento contínuo.


  • Manter-se bem-informado e atualizado, ampliando sua própria competência em relação a conhecimentos sobre riscos em saúde e sobre as medidas mais eficientes para eliminar ou reduzir os riscos relevantes.


  • Respeitar, cumprir e fazer cumprir os ditames do Código de Ética Médica, bem como a Legislação vigente e os regulamentos internos formais da Instituição.


REQUISITOS


Formação Acadêmica:

  • Obrigatório: GRADUAÇÃO EM MEDICINA
  • RESIDÊNCIA MÉDICA OU ESPECIALIZAÇÃO EM ENDOCRINOLOGIA, concluída ou em andamento.


Certificações:

  • Registro ativo no Conselho Regional de Medicina (CRM);
  • Certificado de Título de Especialista - RQE (emitido pelo Conselho respectivo) em Endocrinologia, ou comprovante de matrícula em Residência, Pós Graduação, Especialização em Endocrinologia.
  • Certificado Digital Ativo reconhecido pela Infraestrutura de Chaves Públicas Brasileira (ICP-Brasil).


Experiência:

Experiência em atividades relacionadas à atuação em atendimento médico em Endocrinologia , sendo desejável experiência prévia em Telemedicina e Atenção Primária à Saúde;


Conhecimentos Específicos para a função:

Prestar orientações personalizadas a indivíduos e suas famílias com conhecimentos para o diagnóstico, tratamento e acompanhamento de pacientes com doenças e distúrbios Endócrinos e metabólicos..


Competências Comportamentais:

Comprometimento com os pacientes, com ideais e valores da empresa, apresentando postura ética, pontualidade, capacidade de integração com equipe multiprofissional.


Outros Requisitos Importantes:

Conhecimentos e Habilidades em computação: uso do Pacote Office (Excel, Word, Power Point, Gráficos) e Internet. Familiaridade com tecnologias de telemedicina e uso de plataformas de comunicação virtual é um diferencial desejável.


Local de Trabalho:

REMOTO



IMPORTANTE:


MODELO DE CONTRATAÇÃO: Contratação em regime de Prestador de Serviços por contrato Pessoa Jurídica, necessário fazer parte como representante legal ou sócio de um CNPJ ativo.


REMUNERAÇÃO E AGENDAMENTOS : a negociar durante processo seletivo.


Esta descrição de cargo/atuação tem caráter informativo e pode ser ajustada conforme a necessidade da empresa ou instituição que oferece a oportunidade de trabalho em telemedicina para Médico Clínico/Generalista Residente em Endocrinologia.

title: Professor de inglês
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Professor de inglês em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Faça parte da comunidade de professores que está transformando o ensino de idiomas no Brasil!


Onde os influencers do Brasil fazem suas aulas particulares!


A Idioma Independente , referência em inovação no ensino de idiomas, está buscando pessoas proativas, com perfil proativo e fluência em um segundo idioma, que querem ter sucesso no âmbito profissional, para se credenciar como professores e fazer parte da nossa comunidade engajada.


Aqui, você não será apenas mais um perfil online: você será parte de uma rede colaborativa com mais de 400 professores e 4.000 alunos que vivenciam nossa metodologia transformadora hoje, além de mais de 1000 professores e 10.000 alunos que já fizeram parte desta história.


Nos últimos 12 meses tivemos mais de 22 mil alunos interessados em fazer aulas conosco. Professores novos têm lotado suas agendas em até 30 dias, quando são comprometidos, se comunicam de forma eficaz e tem agenda no horário da noite disponível.


*Esta não é uma vaga CLT*


O que oferecemos?


  • Capacitação intensiva para melhoria no ensino de aulas de acordo com a nossa metodologia inovadora
  • Acesso exclusivo a uma plataforma com mais de 400 vídeos de treinamento, baseada em uma metodologia que já entregou resultados incríveis, com vídeos totalmente atualizados .
  • Mentorias semanais com especialistas experientes, que já treinaram mais de 1500 profissionais.
  • Plataforma exclusiva para acompanhamento das aulas.
  • Participação no nosso processo de captação de alunos, com possibilidade de ganhos adicionais relevantes, bastando você se interessar.
  • Descontos exclusivos em cursos de idiomas e viagens com a nossa comunidade.
  • Possibilidade de desenvolvimento e mentoria para ser um empreendedor de sucesso (se você quiser).
  • Um banco de aulas com mais de 800 aulas para facilitar o seu processo de construção de aulas.
  • Certificações dos treinamentos feitos dentro da comunidade que garantem que você obterá mais resultados juntos aos seus alunos e que agregam na sua carreira como professor independente.


Como saber se você é a pessoa certa para fazer parte da maior comunidade de professores independentes do Brasil?


Se você tem grandes ambições para impactar a educação no Brasil, acredita que o ensino de idiomas precisa de inovação, quer otimizar sua agenda de aulas e, ainda, gostaria de crescer como empreendedor, este é o lugar certo para você.


Necessário:


  • Maior de 18 anos , fluente em Português e outro idioma.
  • Disponibilidade de ao menos 20 horas semanais para treinamentos, aulas e ações práticas Esta é uma necessidade para obter os maiores retornos que a comunidade pode te proporcionar.
  • Possibilidade de participar em capacitações durante a semana, no turno da manhã ou tarde.
  • Independência para executar atividades, espírito de colaboração e vontade de contribuir para uma comunidade.


O diferencial?


Aqui você é mais que um professor.


Você será parte de uma comunidade de professores no ensino de idiomas , onde o trabalho colaborativo é a base para alcançar resultados de mercado altamente competitivos.


Esta não é uma vaga CLT , mas sim uma oportunidade de empreender e ser dono do seu crescimento com total suporte e estrutura de uma empresa inovadora.


Você cria laços e relações de confiança com pessoas que realmente se esforçam para te ajudar no seu desenvolvimento, devido ao modelo de negócio inovador que proporciona relações colaborativas e efetivas.


Se você tem vontade de fazer diferente e de vivenciar algo novo na sua história profissional, a ii com certeza é o seu lugar.


Faça parte da mudança no ensino de idiomas. Junte-se à Idioma Independente e transforme sua carreira e a vida de milhares de alunos!


O que eu faço?


  • Recebo capacitação para dar a melhor aula experimental da sua vida
  • Recebo capacitação em nossa metodologia, aprendendo como transformar a vida de muitos alunos, entregando resultado para eles/as
  • Recebo treinamentos e capacitações recorrentes com mentores experientes e especializados
  • Organizo e escolho a minha agenda e os horários que gostaria de ter alunos/as
  • Preparo aulas para os meus alunos/as
  • Dou as aulas para os meus alunos/as


Se você quiser ir além, também será possível, basta você se engajar na comunidade e aprender mais sobre todas as áreas do seu negócio.


QUANTO EU RECEBO POR ISSO?


  • Se você for somente professor, se dedicando 40h na semana a aulas, você poderá receber até R$4.000,00 por mês.
  • Se você quiser aprender sobre diferentes áreas e se engajar na comunidade, você pode construir uma renda mensal de até R$6.000,00 por mês em aproximadamente 1 ano.
  • Se você realmente quiser crescer e se desenvolver, se dedicando de forma integral junto da comunidade é possível chegar até R$12.000,00 por mês em 2 anos.


Tudo isso só dependerá de você, se quiser aprender mais sobre as partes comerciais e sobre como se tornar um mentor/a de professores.


Seja diferente, seja independente

Oi! Na Bizneo somos uma das maiores plataformas de HR Tech da Europa e LATAM, com mais de 30 módulos de software para gestão de pessoas :) Estamos buscando reforços para o time comercial no Brasil: alguém que curta o jogo da prospecção, entenda rápido um produto complexo e saiba ter uma conversa de verdade com um gestor de RH — não só seguir um script.


O que você vai fazer aqui?


  • Prospectar e abordar empresas do mercado brasileiro por telefone, e-mail e LinkedIn, gerando oportunidades qualificadas para o time de vendas. Este é um papel de SDR/BDR puro: seu foco é abrir portas, não fechar contratos.
  • Entender o cenário de cada prospect: como gerenciam seus processos de RH hoje, quais são suas dores reais e onde a Bizneo pode fazer diferença.
  • Qualificar oportunidades com critério, não com volume. Nos interessa mais uma reunião boa do que dez reuniões fracas.
  • Manter o CRM atualizado e organizado. Dados limpos não são burocracia, são o que faz a máquina comercial funcionar.
  • Colaborar com o time de vendas e marketing para refinar mensagens, cadências e estratégias de abordagem com base no que você vê no campo.


O que buscamos?


  • Experiência prévia em prospecção, pré-vendas (SDR, BDR, Inside Sales) ou vendas internas em empresas de tecnologia ou SaaS. Pode ser pouca, mas tem que ser real.
  • Você é curioso/a sobre o produto que vende. Não quer só agendar reuniões — quer entender o que está vendendo e por que resolve o problema do cliente.
  • Comunicação clara e natural, tanto por escrito quanto por telefone. Sabe adaptar o tom ao interlocutor sem soar robótico.
  • Organização e disciplina no dia a dia: gerenciar pipeline, seguir cadências e cumprir follow-ups sem que ninguém precise cobrar.
  • Gosta de trabalhar com metas e se motiva com resultados, mas entende que consistência importa mais que picos.

  • Já vendeu ou prospectou software de RH, gestão de pessoas ou SaaS B2B para o mercado mid-market.

O que oferecemos?

  • Teletrabalho 100% — para sempre, de qualquer lugar do Brasil.
  • Jornada flexível de segunda a sexta.
  • Treinamento contínuo no produto e em técnicas de venda consultiva.
  • Possibilidades reais de crescimento: vários dos nossos AEs de hoje começaram como SDRs.

Required Qualifications

  • High-impact role supporting business operations and systems strategy
  • Collaborative and fast-growing environment with strong ownership.

About the role

We are looking for a Senior Software Engineer to join a high-impact team focused on building and scaling systems that power pricing, payments, and merchandising within a luxury resale marketplace. This role sits at the intersection of backend engineering and product development, supporting both customer-facing applications and internal tools used by operators and business teams.

title: Cloud Systems Engineer/DevOps
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Cloud Systems Engineer/DevOps em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

About the Product

For more than 30 years, Carnegie has been a leader and innovator in higher education marketing and enrollment strategy, offering groundbreaking services in the areas of Research, Strategy, Digital Marketing, Lead Generation, Slate Optimization, Student Search, Website Development, and Creative that generate authentic connections.


Role Overview

We are seeking an expert-level, highly skilled Cloud Systems Engineer (DevOps) to serve as a GCP Specialist and technical builder for our Google Cloud ecosystem. This role requires more than administration; you must be capable of building architectural change, adjusting systems, and driving modernization efforts. You will be responsible for the end-to-end management of our GCP infrastructure, from complex networking to proactive cost optimization and resource scaling. A key responsibility is leading and running large-scale cloud migration projects, specifically from AWS to GCP.


The ideal candidate ensures our Compute Engine environment is lean, fast, and resilient while maintaining secure connectivity using both native and third-party VPN solutions.

The role’s primary focus demands deep GCP expertise, but candidates must also possess significant experience with AWS for successful migration

strategy.


Key Responsibilities

  • Infrastructure & Networking: Configure and maintain robust networking architectures, including Cloud DNS and Cloud NAT.
  • Linux System Administration: Manage and maintain the operating system environment on Compute Engine instances, including patching, configuration management, user account management, and troubleshooting core system issues.
  • VPN Management: Build and manage secure tunnels using Cloud VPN , pfSense virtual appliances, and CloudConnexa (OpenVPN) for flexible remote access.
  • Performance Monitoring: Utilize Google Cloud Operations Suite to monitor Compute Engine health. Identify bottlenecks and tune instances for peak performance.
  • Resource Management: Oversee persistent disks, snapshots, and storage buckets. Ensure high availability while purging unused resources to maintain environment hygiene.
  • Cost Optimization: Actively monitor billing dashboards, implement committed use discounts (CUDs), and right-size underutilized instances to maintain a lean budget.
  • Database Oversight: Provide support for PostgreSQL and Oracle environments, ensuring seamless integration and performance within the GCP ecosystem.
  • Security & Compliance : Enforce IAM roles and security best practices to protect the project perimeter


Required Qualifications

  • Certification: Active Google Cloud Professional DevOps Engineer certification.
  • Containerization Mastery: Strong expertise with Docker for containerizing applications, managing images, and troubleshooting container runtimes.
  • Scripting Mastery: High proficiency in Python or Bash for automating routine infrastructure tasks, reporting, and task scheduling.
  • Networking Expertise: Hands-on experience managing network routing, firewall rules, and site-to-site VPNs using pfSense and CloudConnexa.
  • Cloud Migration & Project Leadership: Proven experience leading and running application and data migrations from AWS to GCP. This includes the capability to own the end-to-end migration project life cycle and drive solutions.
  • Compute Engine Mastery: Deep understanding of VM lifecycles, custom machine types, and auto-scaling.
  • English Proficiency: Advanced English level (B2–C1 or higher)


Nice-to-Have

  • PostgreSQL Expertise: Strong hands-on experience with configuration, optimization, and query tuning.
  • Oracle Expertise: Experience managing or migrating Oracle database environments.
  • Data & Analytics: Familiarity with BigQuery.


We offer

  • We welcome new ideas and allow you to make an immediate impact on the team.
  • Flexible Paid time off (PTO for any reason, including sick days (no specified limits) and flexible work schedule).
  • Personal laptop.
  • Health and wellness package.
  • Fully remote.


As this is an English-speaking role, we kindly ask that all applications be submitted with a CV in English.

description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Software Team Lead em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Engineering Team Lead | Ruby on Rails

Brazil (Remote) | Supporting a US-Based Fintech Company

Competitive Salary + Leadership Opportunity


A fast-growing US fintech SaaS company is looking for an Engineering Team Lead based in Brazil to help drive the development of a market-leading platform used within the alternative investments space.


Following multiple years of rapid growth, the business is continuing to scale its engineering function and is looking for a hands-on technical leader who enjoys mentoring teams, improving engineering practices, and delivering high-quality software in a collaborative environment.

Their platform digitises complex onboarding, transaction, and reporting workflows for investment firms and service providers, helping reduce operational friction and improve efficiency across the investment lifecycle.


What You’ll Be Doing:

• Leading and supporting a small team of engineers across key product initiatives

• Providing mentorship, coaching, and technical guidance to developers

• Driving best practices across software development, delivery, and collaboration

• Remaining hands-on with development across backend and frontend systems

• Designing and building scalable backend APIs using Ruby on Rails

• Developing modern frontend applications with React.js

• Working closely with Product and Engineering stakeholders to solve user problems

• Supporting continuous improvement across architecture, processes, and team performance


What They’re Looking For:

• Strong commercial software engineering experience

• Previous experience leading or managing small engineering teams

• Experience mentoring, coaching, and supporting engineer development

• Strong experience with Ruby on Rails and React.js

• Comfortable operating in a hands-on leadership role

• Strong communication and stakeholder management skills

• Passion for building scalable products and high-performing teams


Tech Stack:

• Ruby on Rails

• React.js

• RSpec

• AWS (S3, RDS, ECS)

• Argo CI/CD


This is an opportunity to join a high-growth engineering team where you’ll have real ownership, influence over technical direction, and the chance to help shape both the product and engineering culture.

title: Full Stack Developer
description:

About

Flatiron is a global remote software development company with engineers located around the world. We unite experts from diverse backgrounds and experiences in a collaborative culture to deliver exceptional products and services for our clients. As a forward-thinking software engineering company, we provide industry-leading solutions to complex problems in both the US and the UK. Operating in a fast-paced, agile environment, we specialize in software consulting for our clients. We offer a stimulating and rewarding environment for our team members. We value innovation, continuous learning, and professional growth, and we strive to create a workplace where everyone can thrive. Join us at Flatiron and be a part of a team that is shaping the future of software development.


Job Summary

This is a full-time fully remote working opportunity where you will be working as part of a Scrum team which requires working closely with other software engineers, stakeholders and contributors on the project. Working with respect to the US timezone is a requirement for the position. Attending meetings, being actively involved in the decision making process and collaborating with all of these stakeholders are essential parts of this position.


Responsibilities

  • Design and implement scalable, high-performance full stack applications with a strong emphasis on backend architecture.
  • Lead and contribute to the integration of AI/ML features into products, collaborating closely with data scientists and engineers.
  • Develop robust backend services and APIs using Python or Node.js (Express, NestJS) .
  • Contribute to frontend development using React and modern JavaScript/TypeScript practices.
  • Identify, prioritize, and execute tasks throughout the software development lifecycle.
  • Debug, optimize, and maintain backend systems, APIs, and data workflows.
  • Ensure code quality through testing, code reviews, and best engineering practices.
  • Document development phases, monitor system performance, and improve reliability.
  • Participate in Scrum meetings and contribute to product and technical decision-making.


Qualifications

  • Higher education in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field, ideally with a focus on Artificial Intelligence and/or Machine Learning
  • Advanced level of written and oral English proficiency.
  • 4+ years of professional software development experience, with strong backend expertise in Python and/or Node.js.
  • Proficiency with frontend technologies such as React, Next.js, and TypeScript .
  • Hands-on experience deploying ML/AI models into production environments.
  • Familiarity with database technologies such as MySQL, MongoDB, or PostgreSQL.
  • Strong understanding of Object-Oriented Programming, Agile development principles, and cloud environments (AWS, GCP, or Azure).
  • Interest in applied AI and automation-driven development.


Benefits

  • Yearly Office Allowance Budget
  • Macbook Purchase Support
  • Wellbeing Support


If you are a good fit for the position, please apply through LinkedIn.

We only accept CVs that are in English.

title: Senior Frontend Developer (100% Remote Worldwide)
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Senior Frontend Developer (100% Remote Worldwide) em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Join Tether and Shape the Future of Digital Finance

At Tether, we’re not just building products, we’re pioneering a global financial revolution. Our cutting-edge solutions empower businesses—from exchanges and wallets to payment processors and ATMs—to seamlessly integrate reserve-backed tokens across blockchains. By harnessing the power of blockchain technology, Tether enables you to store, send, and receive digital tokens instantly, securely, and globally, all at a fraction of the cost. Transparency is the bedrock of everything we do, ensuring trust in every transaction.


Innovate with Tether

Tether Finance: Our innovative product suite features the world’s most trusted stablecoin, USDT , relied upon by hundreds of millions worldwide, alongside pioneering digital asset tokenization services.

But that’s just the beginning:

Tether Power: Driving sustainable growth, our energy solutions optimize excess power for Bitcoin mining using eco-friendly practices in state-of-the-art, geo-diverse facilities.

Tether Data: Fueling breakthroughs in AI and peer-to-peer technology, we reduce infrastructure costs and enhance global communications with cutting-edge solutions like KEET , our flagship app that redefines secure and private data sharing.

Tether Education : Democratizing access to top-tier digital learning, we empower individuals to thrive in the digital and gig economies, driving global growth and opportunity.

Tether Evolution : At the intersection of technology and human potential, we are pushing the boundaries of what is possible, crafting a future where innovation and human capabilities merge in powerful, unprecedented ways.


Why Join Us?

Our team is a global talent powerhouse, working remotely from every corner of the world. If you’re passionate about making a mark in the fintech space, this is your opportunity to collaborate with some of the brightest minds, pushing boundaries and setting new standards. We’ve grown fast, stayed lean, and secured our place as a leader in the industry.

If you have excellent English communication skills and are ready to contribute to the most innovative platform on the planet, Tether is the place for you.

Are you ready to be part of the future?


About the job

As a senior Frontend Developer, you will be a part of the team that works on the development and maintenance of the frontend components of multiple applications related to the platform. This includes:

  • New Products and Features - Tether continuously strives to create innovative new features in order to provide the most professional experience for customers. These are developed and deployed using agile methodologies, to ensure the user experience remains the best in the industry.
  • Performance - all ui components that power Tether platform must remain effortlessly smooth, responsive, and real-time for customers as the platform continues to scale to accommodate new user growth.
  • Security - Tether makes Security its most important feature. The Frontend Development team is responsible for building all the interactions with API services with the highest security principles and standard, in order to protect the safety of the entire user base.


Responsibilities

Collaborate with the team to work on the development of the Bitfinex KYC webapps. Including:

  • New Features: Create innovative new features in order to provide the most professional KYC experience for customers and compliance officers. These are developed and deployed using agile methodologies.
  • Scalability: The web application must remain effortlessly smooth, responsive, and real-time for customers as the platform continues to scale to accommodate new user growth.
  • Design: Build beautiful reactive applications and trading tools.
  • Domain knowledge: willing to learn the domain-related logic and condition-based logic, including the one based on difference between multiple users scenarios and combinations of factors
  • Debugging: Being able to debug hidden/hard to find issues when needed, advanced usage of browser debugging tools, including network, source, stop points etc.


Requirements

  • With 5+ years of proven experience in software development, with a strong focus on Frontend.
  • Knowledgeable and experienced with micro-service architecture.
  • Comfortable with high-availability concepts.
  • Highly proficient in JavaScript and ES6+.
  • Thoroughly experienced with React, SASS, Redux, build tools and the core principles surrounding these.
  • Some backend experience to be able to run the app locally via NodeJS, with MongoDB, configuring ports and local environment
  • Familiar with modern front-end pipelines and tools.
  • Experienced with RESTful and RPC-based APIs.
  • Interest in bringing diverse, innovative applications to life.
  • Interest in modernising and optimising different web applications.


Important information for candidates

Recruitment scams have become increasingly common. To protect yourself, please keep the following in mind when applying for roles:

  • Apply only through our official channels. We do not use third-party platforms or agencies for recruitment unless clearly stated. All open roles are listed on our official careers page:
  • Verify the recruiter’s identity. All our recruiters have verified LinkedIn profiles. If you’re unsure, you can confirm their identity by checking their profile or contacting us through our website.
  • Be cautious of unusual communication methods. We do not conduct interviews over WhatsApp, Telegram, or SMS. All communication is done through official company emails and platforms.
  • Double-check email addresses. All communication from us will come from emails ending in @ tether.to or @ tether.io
  • We will never request payment or financial details. If someone asks for personal financial information or payment at any point during the hiring process, it is a scam. Please report it immediately.

When in doubt, feel free to reach out through our official website.

title: Cloud Systems Engineer/DevOps
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Cloud Systems Engineer/DevOps em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

About the Product

For more than 30 years, Carnegie has been a leader and innovator in higher education marketing and enrollment strategy, offering groundbreaking services in the areas of Research, Strategy, Digital Marketing, Lead Generation, Slate Optimization, Student Search, Website Development, and Creative that generate authentic connections.


Role Overview

We are seeking an expert-level, highly skilled Cloud Systems Engineer (DevOps) to serve as a GCP Specialist and technical builder for our Google Cloud ecosystem. This role requires more than administration; you must be capable of building architectural change, adjusting systems, and driving modernization efforts. You will be responsible for the end-to-end management of our GCP infrastructure, from complex networking to proactive cost optimization and resource scaling. A key responsibility is leading and running large-scale cloud migration projects, specifically from AWS to GCP.


The ideal candidate ensures our Compute Engine environment is lean, fast, and resilient while maintaining secure connectivity using both native and third-party VPN solutions.

The role’s primary focus demands deep GCP expertise, but candidates must also possess significant experience with AWS for successful migration

strategy.


Key Responsibilities

  • Infrastructure & Networking: Configure and maintain robust networking architectures, including Cloud DNS and Cloud NAT.
  • Linux System Administration: Manage and maintain the operating system environment on Compute Engine instances, including patching, configuration management, user account management, and troubleshooting core system issues.
  • VPN Management: Build and manage secure tunnels using Cloud VPN , pfSense virtual appliances, and CloudConnexa (OpenVPN) for flexible remote access.
  • Performance Monitoring: Utilize Google Cloud Operations Suite to monitor Compute Engine health. Identify bottlenecks and tune instances for peak performance.
  • Resource Management: Oversee persistent disks, snapshots, and storage buckets. Ensure high availability while purging unused resources to maintain environment hygiene.
  • Cost Optimization: Actively monitor billing dashboards, implement committed use discounts (CUDs), and right-size underutilized instances to maintain a lean budget.
  • Database Oversight: Provide support for PostgreSQL and Oracle environments, ensuring seamless integration and performance within the GCP ecosystem.
  • Security & Compliance : Enforce IAM roles and security best practices to protect the project perimeter


Required Qualifications

  • Certification: Active Google Cloud Professional DevOps Engineer certification.
  • Containerization Mastery: Strong expertise with Docker for containerizing applications, managing images, and troubleshooting container runtimes.
  • Scripting Mastery: High proficiency in Python or Bash for automating routine infrastructure tasks, reporting, and task scheduling.
  • Networking Expertise: Hands-on experience managing network routing, firewall rules, and site-to-site VPNs using pfSense and CloudConnexa.
  • Cloud Migration & Project Leadership: Proven experience leading and running application and data migrations from AWS to GCP. This includes the capability to own the end-to-end migration project life cycle and drive solutions.
  • Compute Engine Mastery: Deep understanding of VM lifecycles, custom machine types, and auto-scaling.
  • English Proficiency: Advanced English level (B2–C1 or higher)


Nice-to-Have

  • PostgreSQL Expertise: Strong hands-on experience with configuration, optimization, and query tuning.
  • Oracle Expertise: Experience managing or migrating Oracle database environments.
  • Data & Analytics: Familiarity with BigQuery.


We offer

  • We welcome new ideas and allow you to make an immediate impact on the team.
  • Flexible Paid time off (PTO for any reason, including sick days (no specified limits) and flexible work schedule).
  • Personal laptop.
  • Health and wellness package.
  • Fully remote.


As this is an English-speaking role, we kindly ask that all applications be submitted with a CV in English.

title: Sr AI Engineer - Brazil
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Sr AI Engineer - Brazil em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar. Senior AI Engineer


PITZ | Remote | Reports to CTO

A trillion-dollar industry still runs on phone calls. We're building the intelligence that replaces it.

PITZ is the infrastructure layer for the global automotive aftermarket. A mechanic speaks — in Spanish, Portuguese, or English, in a noisy shop — and our system diagnoses the failure, identifies the exact part, selects the supplier, underwrites credit, and executes the order. No screen. No typing. No human in the loop.

We're live in Mexico and Brazil. Entering the US this year. And we need someone to build the brain behind all of it.

Why this role exists

We're not hiring a cog for an AI team. There is no AI team yet. You'd be the first dedicated AI hire. You'll work directly with the CEO to design and build the entire intelligence layer — voice pipeline, recommendation engine, credit scoring, and the data flywheel that makes everything compound.

If you deliver, you become Head of AI within 12 months. Not as a title bump — because you'll have built the thing from scratch and no one will know it better than you.

This is a role for someone who's been a Senior ML Engineer or AI Lead somewhere and knows they're ready for more — but hasn't had the chance to prove it because there's always someone above them.

Here, there's no one above you. Just the problem and the product.

What you'll build

The voice-to-action pipeline.  Mechanic speech in noisy shops → intent extraction → diagnostic prediction → SKU mapping from millions of parts → order execution. Three languages. Regional slang. Background noise. Real world, not a lab.

The recommendation engine.  Right part, right seller, right price, right delivery. This is where margin lives. Every percentage point of improvement moves real revenue.

The credit scoring models.  Behavioral underwriting for mechanics with no credit history. Turn operational data — order frequency, payment patterns, voice engagement — into financial signals.

The data flywheel.  Every interaction makes the system smarter. You design the architecture that turns daily transactions into compounding intelligence.

US market integrations.  Connect PITZ to Identifix, ALLDATA, OBD platforms, PartsTech, Mitchell1. Adapt models for the US vehicle fleet and English-speaking mechanics.

What you bring

3-5 years building ML/AI systems in production.  Not notebooks. Not demos. Systems that real users interact with daily and that break in interesting ways.

NLP or voice experience.  You've worked with speech recognition, intent extraction, text classification, or conversational AI. Bonus if it was in noisy, multilingual, or domain-specific environments.

Full-stack ML instincts.  You can train a model, build the data pipeline, optimize inference, deploy it, and monitor it. You don't wait for a platform team — you are the platform team.

Builder mentality.  You've worked in startups or fast-moving environments. You ship fast. You make decisions with 70% of the data. You'd rather build something imperfect today than plan something perfect for next quarter.

Fluent English required. Spanish or Portuguese strongly preferred.  You'll work with mechanics, ops teams, and partners across three countries.


Requirements


Timezone:  Must be available during US/LatAm business hours (UTC-3 to UTC-8). This is a real-time collaboration role, not async.

Commitment:  This is a full-time, dedicated position. If you're currently juggling multiple roles — this isn't a fit. We need 100%.

Travel:  Periodic travel to Mexico City and São Paulo. You'll visit workshops, hear mechanics, and see the product in action. If you've never left your desk to watch a user interact with your model — this will change that.


What makes this different

At most companies, a Senior AI Engineer optimizes a model inside a product someone else designed. Here, you design the product. The intelligence layer IS the product. There's no PM handing you a spec. There's no VP of AI telling you the roadmap. You figure out what to build, you build it, and you see it run a real supply chain the next day.

You'll work with proprietary data that doesn't exist anywhere else — millions of real mechanic-to-system interactions mapped to parts, orders, payments, and outcomes. Your models get better not because of more compute, but because of more reality.

And if you prove you can own this — you lead the team we build around it.

Experiência em atividades relacionadas à atuação em atendimento médico em Oncologia sendo desejável experiência prévia em Telemedicina.

Competência em prestar orientações personalizadas a indivíduos e suas famílias com conhecimentos para o diagnóstico, tratamento e acompanhamento de pacientes com doenças e distúrbios nefrológicos.



Competências Comportamentais:

Comprometimento com os pacientes, com ideais e valores da empresa, apresentando postura ética, pontualidade, capacidade de integração com equipe multiprofissional.

Conhecimentos e Habilidades em computação: uso do Pacote Office (Excel, Word, Power Point, Gráficos) e Internet. Familiaridade com tecnologias de telemedicina e uso de plataformas de comunicação virtual é um diferencial desejável.

Job Summary

We are seeking a highly experienced Senior AI‑Native Backend Engineer with deep expertise in Java to design, build, and operate scalable, secure, and compliant backend systems that power agentic AI workflows.

This role is central to enabling AI‑driven decision pipelines by integrating internal AI platforms (e.g., NASH), external AI services, enterprise data sources, and compliance systems through well‑orchestrated backend services.

The ideal candidate combines strong Java engineering fundamentals, distributed systems expertise, and hands‑on experience implementing AI orchestration, rule application, and explainable decision flows in regulated, enterprise environments.

AI‑Native Backend & Agentic Orchestration

Design, build, and maintain backend services in Java that support agentic AI pipelines

Implement agentic workflows that route content and data through internal AI platforms (e.g., NASH), applying compliance rules, metadata, and review logic

Develop APIs and services that enable:

Context enrichment

Rule evaluation

Decision orchestration

Explainable AI outcomes

Orchestrate interactions between:

Internal AI platforms (NASH)

External AI services (Azure AI, AWS AI)

Enterprise data and compliance systems

Architecture & Distributed Systems

Lead architectural discussions for AI‑driven backend platforms

Design scalable, resilient, and secure microservices architectures

Ensure high performance, reliability, and fault tolerance in production AI workflows

Apply solid object‑oriented design, design patterns, and domain‑driven principles

Governance, Compliance & Security

Embed governance, auditability, traceability, and explainability into all AI‑enabled backend services

Ensure secure data handling and compliance with enterprise and regulatory standards

Implement logging, monitoring, and audit trails for AI‑driven decisions

Enforce backend security best practices (OAuth2, JWT, secure API design)

Engineering Excellence & Collaboration

Write clean, maintainable, and well‑tested Java code following best practices

Perform code reviews and raise engineering standards across teams

Collaborate with frontend, AI, data, product, and compliance teams

Mentor junior and mid‑level engineers

Actively contribute to Agile/Scrum ceremonies and continuous improvement

Required Qualifications and Experience

10+ years of professional experience in Java backend development

Strong expertise in core Java (Java 8+)

Proven experience building enterprise‑grade, distributed systems

Strong experience with RESTful APIs and microservices

Hands‑on experience developing backend integration services and orchestration layers

Solid understanding of:

Object‑oriented design

Design patterns

Software engineering best practices

Experience with relational databases (PostgreSQL, MySQL, Oracle)

Proficiency with Git, Maven/Gradle, and CI/CD pipelines

Strong debugging, troubleshooting, and performance optimization skills

Preferred Skills and Technologies

Frameworks: Spring Boot, Spring MVC, Spring Cloud

Experience supporting or integrating AI/ML and LLM‑based systems

Familiarity with agentic AI workflows and AI orchestration concepts

Cloud platforms: AWS, Azure, or GCP

Containerization & orchestration: Docker, Kubernetes

Messaging systems: Kafka, RabbitMQ

NoSQL databases: MongoDB, Cassandra

Monitoring & observability: Prometheus, ELK stack, Splunk

Understanding of AI governance, compliance, and responsible AI practices

Frontend exposure (Angular, React) is a plus for cross‑stack collaboration

Soft Skills and Competencies

Strong analytical and problem‑solving skills

Excellent communication and collaboration abilities

Proven leadership in technical discussions and system design

High ownership and accountability

Ability to work independently and in cross‑functional teams

Adaptability and continuous learning mindset

Strong organizational and time‑management skills

Education Requirements

Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or related field

Master’s degree is a plus

description:

We’re hiring: Social Lead / Social Media & Community Manager

Earned Media Productions (EMP) is looking for someone who can turn podcasts into growth engines — and build engaged communities around them.

This role sits at the intersection of content distribution, social strategy, and audience engagement.


What you’ll do:

• Own daily posting across TikTok, IG Reels, YouTube Shorts, X, and more

• Turn podcast episodes into high-performing short-form content

• Decide what clips get posted, when, and where

• Manage comments, DMs, and community engagement across platforms

• Help shape the voice and presence of brands online

• Analyze performance and double down on what works


Key Responsibilities 1. Content Distribution & Posting
  • Own daily posting across all social platforms (TikTok, IG Reels, YouTube Shorts, X, etc.)
  • Manage scheduling, captions, hashtags, and formatting per platform
  • Ensure consistent, high-volume output of podcast clips
2. Podcast Clip Strategy
  • Turn long-form podcast episodes into a structured content distribution plan
  • Decide what clips get posted, when, and where
  • Collaborate with editors to guide clip selection and packaging (hooks, titles, formats)
3. Growth & Optimization
  • Analyze performance data to identify winning formats, topics, and hooks
  • Continuously iterate on posting strategy to increase:
  • Views
  • Engagement
  • Follower growth
  • A/B test captions, formats, and posting times
4. Platform Expertise
  • Stay on top of trends, algorithm changes, and best practices across platforms
  • Adapt content strategy accordingly (e.g., TikTok vs. Reels vs. Shorts nuances)
5. Systems & Organization
  • Build and manage a content calendar + distribution system
  • Track posted content and performance metrics
  • Ensure no content bottlenecks between editing → posting → reporting
6. Collaboration
  • Work closely with:
  • Editors (to refine clips)
  • Creators/clients (to align on voice and goals)
  • Leadership (to align on growth strategy)


What we’re looking for:

• Experience growing social accounts (especially short-form video)

• Strong understanding of TikTok / Reels / Shorts

• Someone who actually gets internet culture + audience behavior

• Ability to manage both content output + community interaction

Must-Haves
  • 2–4+ years managing social media accounts (preferably podcast or creator-led content)
  • Proven experience growing accounts through short-form video
  • Deep understanding of TikTok, Instagram Reels, and YouTube Shorts
  • Strong instincts for what makes content go viral
  • Experience managing high-volume posting (multiple posts/day)
  • Fluent in English - Speaking and Writing. 
Nice-to-Haves
  • Experience working with podcasts or long-form content
  • Background in content editing or scripting
  • Familiarity with tools like:
  • Asana/ Slack
  • Social schedulers (Later, Hootsuite, etc.)
  • Analytics tools
  • Experience managing multiple brands or clients
Bonus:

• Experience with podcasts or creator-led brands

• Background in content editing or scripting

• Experience building or managing online communities

This is a high-impact role with real ownership across content, distribution, and community.
