  • Garantir disponibilidade, confiabilidade, segurança e qualidade dos dados para consumo downstream.


Requisitos e qualificações


  • Graduação em Ciência da Computação, Engenharia, Sistemas de Informação ou áreas correlatas;
  • Experiência prática e sólida com Oracle GoldenGate em processos de ingestão de dados e CDC (Change Data Capture), incluindo replicação em tempo real e quase tempo real;
  • Vivência no desenvolvimento, sustentação e otimização de pipelines de dados escaláveis e distribuídos;
  • Experiência com ecossistema Microsoft Azure, incluindo Azure Data Factory, Azure Data Lake e Azure Data Lake Storage Gen2;
  • Forte conhecimento em Databricks e processamento distribuído utilizando Spark;
  • Experiência em arquiteturas modernas de dados, como Lakehouse, trabalhando com camadas Bronze, Silver e Gold;
  • Vivência com cargas full e incrementais (delta load), garantindo integridade, consistência e sincronização dos dados;
  • Conhecimento em monitoramento de pipelines, troubleshooting, tuning de performance e otimização de custos em ambientes cloud;
  • Experiência com dados estruturados e semiestruturados voltados para analytics, reporting e iniciativas de IA/ML;
  • Conhecimento em governança de dados, catálogo, lineage, segurança e boas práticas de arquitetura corporativa;
  • Capacidade de atuar de forma colaborativa com arquitetos de dados, times analíticos e stakeholders de negócio.

title: Senior .Net Engineer (WFH)
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Senior .Net Engineer (WFH) em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Senior .Net Engineer


Resume: English Version only. Resume should have detailed discussion of project overview and job description. Highlight the following if applicable - Maui (Blazor, Razor, Xamarin); Healthcare projects; HIPAA knowledge; SAAS projects; US-based projects

Role: Full time contractor; Fully Remote

Work Hours : US time zone

Location: Brazil

Rate: R$20,000-22,000 per month


About the Company

We are a forward-thinking technology organization dedicated to developing innovative software solutions that improve outcomes for clients and end-users. Our engineering team designs, builds, and maintains scalable, high-quality applications that drive efficiency and innovation across industries. We are seeking an experienced Level III Software Engineer (contractor) to join our distributed team, contributing to complex projects with a focus on code quality, security, and collaboration.


Position Overview

As a Level III Software Engineer (contractor), you will apply your technical expertise to deliver high-quality code for moderately to highly complex projects. Working remotely with a U.S.-based team, you'll gain deep system knowledge and contribute to an Agile development workflow using Azure DevOps.

You will begin with automated testing and peer reviews, expanding into broader development tasks by months 2–3. The role will continue to evolve based on your strengths and project needs, while maintaining rigorous adherence to coding and security standards.


Key Responsibilities

  • Product Design & Development: Collaborate with stakeholders to design and implement software solutions aligned with technical and business objectives.
  • Code Contributions: Write, optimize, and maintain efficient code, including enhancement of existing codebases, beginning around months 3–4.
  • Testing & Quality: Design and implement automated end-to-end (E2E) tests (e.g., using Microsoft Playwright) to ensure feature stability—especially during the first 6–9 months.
  • Peer Reviews: Participate in pre-release feature reviews and early post-release bug analysis (first 90 days), transitioning to broader ownership over time.
  • Agile Workflow Participation: Actively contribute to sprints, pull requests, and releases within a 2-week sprint / 6-week release cycle using Azure DevOps.
  • Collaboration: Communicate effectively with both technical and non-technical team members across multiple time zones.


Qualifications


Experience

  • 5–8 years of software engineering experience with a demonstrated record of success on complex projects.


Technical Skills

  • Proficiency in C# ASP.NET (.NET 8) for web applications and APIs.
  • Experience with .NET MAUI and Blazor Web Applications (.NET 8) , leveraging web expertise for cross-platform or mobile development.
  • Familiarity with Microsoft Azure services, including Azure App Service, Azure SQL, and Azure Storage.
  • Strong understanding of modern development tools (e.g., Visual Studio, Git, Azure DevOps).
  • Knowledge of secure coding practices and general cybersecurity principles.
  • Experience with cloud platforms and Agile methodologies .


Soft Skills

  • Excellent problem-solving and analytical abilities.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills for remote collaboration.
  • Ability to work independently and within a collaborative team environment.


Preferred

  • Experience with regulated or data-sensitive software environments (e.g., healthcare, financial services, HIPAA, PHI).
  • Prior experience conducting pull-request reviews and participating in Agile sprints.


What We Offer

  • Opportunity to work on impactful, large-scale technology projects.
  • Collaborative, high-performance engineering culture focused on quality and innovation.
  • Flexible remote work environment with a structured onboarding process for success.


How We Work

  • Agile Workflow: Two-week sprints within a six-week release cycle, including daily stand-ups (3:00 PM CT), sprint planning, and reviews.
  • Code Standards: Strict adherence to best practices, peer reviews, and security testing (e.g., OWASP, Detectify).
  • Tool Stack: Azure DevOps, Visual Studio, SQL Server Management Studio, Datadog, Microsoft Playwright, and related technologies.
  • Team Culture: A focus on accountability, collaboration, and excellence in delivery.

title: Senior .Net Engineer (WFH)
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Senior .Net Engineer (WFH) em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Senior .Net Engineer


Resume: English Version only. Resume should have detailed discussion of project overview and job description. Highlight the following if applicable - Maui (Blazor, Razor, Xamarin); Healthcare projects; HIPAA knowledge; SAAS projects; US-based projects

Role: Full time contractor; Fully Remote

Work Hours : US time zone

Location: Brazil

Rate: R$20,000-22,000 per month


About the Company

We are a forward-thinking technology organization dedicated to developing innovative software solutions that improve outcomes for clients and end-users. Our engineering team designs, builds, and maintains scalable, high-quality applications that drive efficiency and innovation across industries. We are seeking an experienced Level III Software Engineer (contractor) to join our distributed team, contributing to complex projects with a focus on code quality, security, and collaboration.


Position Overview

As a Level III Software Engineer (contractor), you will apply your technical expertise to deliver high-quality code for moderately to highly complex projects. Working remotely with a U.S.-based team, you'll gain deep system knowledge and contribute to an Agile development workflow using Azure DevOps.

You will begin with automated testing and peer reviews, expanding into broader development tasks by months 2–3. The role will continue to evolve based on your strengths and project needs, while maintaining rigorous adherence to coding and security standards.


Key Responsibilities

  • Product Design & Development: Collaborate with stakeholders to design and implement software solutions aligned with technical and business objectives.
  • Code Contributions: Write, optimize, and maintain efficient code, including enhancement of existing codebases, beginning around months 3–4.
  • Testing & Quality: Design and implement automated end-to-end (E2E) tests (e.g., using Microsoft Playwright) to ensure feature stability—especially during the first 6–9 months.
  • Peer Reviews: Participate in pre-release feature reviews and early post-release bug analysis (first 90 days), transitioning to broader ownership over time.
  • Agile Workflow Participation: Actively contribute to sprints, pull requests, and releases within a 2-week sprint / 6-week release cycle using Azure DevOps.
  • Collaboration: Communicate effectively with both technical and non-technical team members across multiple time zones.


Qualifications


Experience

  • 5–8 years of software engineering experience with a demonstrated record of success on complex projects.


Technical Skills

  • Proficiency in C# ASP.NET (.NET 8) for web applications and APIs.
  • Experience with .NET MAUI and Blazor Web Applications (.NET 8) , leveraging web expertise for cross-platform or mobile development.
  • Familiarity with Microsoft Azure services, including Azure App Service, Azure SQL, and Azure Storage.
  • Strong understanding of modern development tools (e.g., Visual Studio, Git, Azure DevOps).
  • Knowledge of secure coding practices and general cybersecurity principles.
  • Experience with cloud platforms and Agile methodologies .


Soft Skills

  • Excellent problem-solving and analytical abilities.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills for remote collaboration.
  • Ability to work independently and within a collaborative team environment.


Preferred

  • Experience with regulated or data-sensitive software environments (e.g., healthcare, financial services, HIPAA, PHI).
  • Prior experience conducting pull-request reviews and participating in Agile sprints.


What We Offer

  • Opportunity to work on impactful, large-scale technology projects.
  • Collaborative, high-performance engineering culture focused on quality and innovation.
  • Flexible remote work environment with a structured onboarding process for success.


How We Work

  • Agile Workflow: Two-week sprints within a six-week release cycle, including daily stand-ups (3:00 PM CT), sprint planning, and reviews.
  • Code Standards: Strict adherence to best practices, peer reviews, and security testing (e.g., OWASP, Detectify).
  • Tool Stack: Azure DevOps, Visual Studio, SQL Server Management Studio, Datadog, Microsoft Playwright, and related technologies.
  • Team Culture: A focus on accountability, collaboration, and excellence in delivery.

  • Language platform, with conversation classes in 12 languages;

What makes us different?

  • Our organisational culture is based on solid values: commitment, excellence, team spirit, well-being, happiness and empathy;

  • We promote closeness and an informal environment;
  • Here, you will grow in good company, because we believe that professional development also means sharing experiences and building relationships.


Your next adventure starts here!

If you can see yourself growing with us, take the first step and send your CV!

The future is waiting for you — and so are we!

We now have more than 400 associates and we keep growing, with offices in Lisbon, Porto, and Leiria, as well as projects in more than 20 countries. title: Tech Lead | Analytics & AI
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Tech Lead | Analytics & AI em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Procuramos uma pessoa Tech Lead de AI para liderar tecnicamente a construção de soluções baseadas em IA Generativa, arquiteturas de agentes e sistemas inteligentes aplicados ao produto.

Essa posição terá papel estratégico na evolução da arquitetura de IA da Sankhya, conectando modelos de linguagem, contexto de dados e automação de decisões para resolver problemas reais de negócio em escala.

Buscamos alguém que combine profundidade técnica em GenAI, visão arquitetural e liderança hands-on, atuando próximo ao time, produto e arquitetura para construir plataformas de inteligência que integrem IA ao core das soluções da empresa.


RESPONSABILIDADES E ATRIBUIÇÕES

● Liderar tecnicamente o desenvolvimento de soluções baseadas em IA Generativa e arquiteturas de agentes aplicadas ao produto

● Definir padrões e arquitetura para sistemas inteligentes, pipelines de GenAI e workflows de agentes

● Apoiar o time na construção de RAGs, agentes autônomos e mecanismos de contexto (MCPs)

● Atuar hands-on em iniciativas técnicas estratégicas ou de maior complexidade

● Traduzir desafios de negócio em soluções baseadas em IA aplicada e automação inteligente

● Definir boas práticas de engenharia para integração de LLMs com sistemas corporativos

● Liderar experimentação e evolução de provas de conceito de IA aplicada ao produto

● Garantir qualidade técnica através de code review, testes e observabilidade de sistemas de IA

● Monitorar performance, qualidade e riscos de soluções baseadas em modelos de IA

● Mentorar e desenvolver o time técnico, apoiando evolução de carreira e maturidade de engenharia

● Atuar como ponte entre tecnologia, produto e arquitetura, apoiando decisões técnicas estratégicas


REQUISITOS E QUALIFICAÇÕES

Experiência essencial

● Experiência sólida com IA Generativa aplicada a produto

● Experiência com arquiteturas de agentes e workflows de LLMs

● Vivência prática com RAG, embeddings e vector databases

● Experiência com frameworks de agentes como LangChain, LangGraph ou similares

● Experiência integrando LLMs via APIs ou plataformas de IA (ex.: AWS Bedrock)

● Experiência colocando sistemas de IA ou ML em produção

● Forte experiência com Python para backend

● Domínio de boas práticas de arquitetura de software e atuação como referência técnica

Experiência complementar

● Conhecimento em Machine Learning tradicional

● Experiência com engenharia de dados e pipelines de dados

● Experiência com arquitetura de sistemas distribuídos

● Vivência com governança de dados ou plataformas de dados em escala


LOCALIDADE

Uberlândia/MG – Presencial

São Paulo/SP – Híbrido (2x/semana no escritório)

Outras localidades – Remoto

▪️ Regime de contratação: CLT


BENEFÍCIOS

Participação nos Resultados (PPR)

title: Senior OutSystems Engineer
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Senior OutSystems Engineer em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Senior OutSystems Engineer


About the Role

We are seeking a Senior OutSystems Engineer to lead platform stabilization and migration readiness efforts for a large-scale clinical application supporting 130+ locations nationwide. This is a highly hands-on, high-impact role focused on improving system performance, reducing risk, and preparing the platform for an eventual transition to a custom-built solution.


This engagement is expected to begin late April or early May and run approximately 6 weeks, with strong potential for extension based on performance.


What You’ll Do

Stabilize and Modernize Architecture

Assess tightly coupled module architecture and reduce dependencies

Identify and execute module extraction strategies to improve scalability

Minimize risk and blast radius of ongoing changes without disrupting workflows

Optimize Database and System Performance

Improve database performance by optimizing queries and implementing indexing strategies

Design and execute migration of binary large objects out of the database

Replace inefficient polling with event-driven or conditional patterns

Implement backpressure controls for integrations impacting system performance

Reduce Error Noise and Improve Observability

Identify and remediate recurring error patterns masking real issues

Refactor exception handling and client-side lifecycle violations

Establish a clean, monitorable baseline for system health

Build a Real Release Pipeline

Establish a true multi-environment deployment pipeline

Configure deployment automation using OutSystems APIs

Implement gated release processes with approvals and controls

Ensure non-production environments support meaningful regression testing

Manage Platform Capacity and Licensing

Audit platform usage and identify optimization opportunities

Remove unused or redundant components

Define governance for capacity-impacting changes

Extend platform headroom without impacting functionality

Prepare for Migration to Custom Platform

Document all integrations including triggers, data contracts, and failure modes

Map data entities into portable schemas

Capture business logic embedded within the platform

Identify core business logic vs platform-generated components

Advise on migration sequencing and risk across workflows


What You Bring

Required Experience

5+ years building and maintaining enterprise-scale OutSystems applications

Deep experience with OutSystems 11, Service Studio, and Lifetime API

Proven success optimizing performance including query tuning and data model improvements

Experience refactoring complex, tightly coupled systems into modular architectures

Strong SQL Server performance tuning experience including execution plans and indexing

Hands-on experience with CI/CD pipelines and deployment automation within OutSystems

Strong problem-solving skills in live production environments

Preferred Experience

Experience supporting or leading OutSystems to custom platform migrations

Background in healthcare or clinical systems with understanding of critical workflows

Familiarity with HIPAA considerations and secure data handling

Experience with license optimization and application object management

Knowledge of integration patterns across scheduling, e-signature, or CRM systems

Working Environment

Collaborate closely with internal engineering and PM leadership

Operate with high autonomy and ownership of technical decisions

Work within a live production environment supporting critical clinical operations

Balance speed and precision while minimizing risk to end users


This is a unique opportunity to step into a complex, high-visibility system, make immediate impact, and shape the foundation for a next-generation platform.

title: Post Producer
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Post Producer em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Post Producer

Location: Remote

Position Type: Contract

Company: Pocket FM



About Us

At Pocket FM, our mission is to deliver immersive storytelling experiences to a global audience. With a global audience of over 200 million listeners, we are redefining entertainment through episodic audio storytelling across diverse genres. We are seeking a highly organized and creative Creative Producer to manage and oversee the end-to-end production of high-quality audio content.

Role Overview

As a Creative Producer , you will play a key role in managing the end-to-end production process of audio content across various formats on Pocket FM. You will collaborate closely with writers, voice artists, creators, and production teams to ensure timely delivery of high-quality episodes. The role requires strong operational management, creative oversight, and the ability to coordinate across multiple stakeholders to deliver compelling audio experiences for our listeners.



Key Responsibilities

1. Post Production Operations Management

Oversee day-to-day post-production operations for ongoing audio shows and promotional adds, ensuring smooth workflows from raw audio to final delivery. Manage editing, sound design, mixing, and mastering pipelines to meet release schedules.

2. Post Production Team Coordination

Work closely with editors, sound designers, mixing engineers, and external post-production vendors to deliver high-quality audio content. Ensure clear briefs, efficient collaboration, and consistency across outputs.

3. Production Planning & Pipeline Management

Collaborate with content and production teams to plan post-production schedules, track weekly deliverables, and ensure timely completion of all episodes. Proactively identify and resolve bottlenecks in the pipeline.

4. Stakeholder Collaboration

Coordinate with cross-functional teams including Content, Marketing, Product, and Quality Control to align on timelines, creative requirements, and delivery standards.

5. Audio Quality & Finishing Oversight

Own the final quality of all audio outputs, including editing precision, sound design, mixing balance, mastering levels, and overall listening experience. Ensure all content meets defined technical and creative benchmarks before release.

6. Vendor & Partner Management

Build and manage a network of external studios, freelancers, and post-production partners to support scalable content production. Ensure quality, consistency, and timely delivery across partners.

7. Feedback Integration & Continuous Improvement

Monitor listener feedback and internal QC inputs to identify issues related to audio clarity, pacing, sound design, or technical quality. Drive improvements across post-production processes.

8. Process & Workflow Optimization

Continuously enhance post-production workflows, tools, and standards to improve efficiency, scalability, and output quality. Document best practices, templates, and guidelines for consistent execution.

9. Volume & Deadline Management

Manage high-volume content pipelines across multiple shows, ensuring all deadlines are met without compromising on audio quality or production standards.

10. Quality Control Training & Creative Alignment

Continuously train and support QC team members responsible for assigned shows to ensure strong alignment on creative direction, audio quality standards, storytelling expectations, and technical benchmarks. Work closely with QC specialists on a weekly basis to review content, calibrate feedback, identify recurring issues, and maintain consistency across shows and post-production outputs.


11. Internal Promotional Video Post-Production Leadership

Lead the internal post-production team for promotional video assets, aligning editors, sound designers, and mixers around consistent quality standards, sonic identity, creative style, and delivery expectations. Ensure all promotional videos maintain a cohesive audio language, polished sound design, and production value aligned with brand and marketing objectives.

12. AI-driven Innovations and tool adotion

Leverage AI-powered tools and emerging technologies across editing, sound design, voice processing, mixing, mastering, QC, and workflow automation to improve efficiency, scalability, and creative quality. Stay updated on evolving AI trends in post-production and evaluate new tools/workflows that enhance turnaround time, consistency, audio quality, and overall production effectiveness while maintaining strong creative and editorial standards.



Qualifications

  • 7+ years of experience in post-production, audio production, or media production, with a strong focus on editing, sound design, and final delivery workflows.
  • Solid understanding of audio storytelling and hands-on experience across post-production stages, including editing, mixing, mastering, and finishing for podcasts or audiobooks.
  • Proven experience working with post-production teams such as editors, sound designers, mixing engineers, or external production vendors.
  • Strong project management and organizational skills, with the ability to manage multiple post-production pipelines and deadlines simultaneously.
  • Effective stakeholder management and communication skills, with experience collaborating across content, production, and quality teams.
  • Ability to operate in fast-paced, high-volume production environments while maintaining consistent quality standards.
  • Self-driven with strong problem-solving capabilities and a proactive approach to identifying and resolving production challenges.

What is Teachable?

Teachable is trusted by creator-educators around the world to grow their impact and income. From online courses and communities to memberships and downloads, Teachable's digital learning products help creator-educators drive meaningful connection and sustainable revenue. With industry-best ecommerce tools, easily toggled on directly within the platform, creators can confidently maximize their earnings, while getting paid directly by their audience. Teachable's unmatched focus on the student learning experience also ensures creators can make a positive and influential impact on their communities—entirely on their own terms. Today, tens of thousands of creator-educators use Teachable to share their knowledge, reaching millions of students around the world. To learn more, visit teachable.com.


Are you ready to join a dynamic, cross-cultural team at an exciting turning point in our company’s journey? Now part of the global Hotmart Company portfolio, whose platforms have helped creators earn more than $10 billion, Teachable continues to take the creator economy by storm as a true industry leader. Together, Teachable and Hotmart are delivering market-leading products that prioritize creator control and flexibility, alongside meaningful partnership and support from our team. If you have big ideas, relish the chance to challenge convention, and deeply believe in the power of creators to shape the future, we want you on our team!


Your Mission

We are seeking a highly analytical and strategic Customer Success Operations Sr Analyst to strengthen our Customer Success strategy and accelerate our go-to-market engine in a rapidly growing SaaS company. You will partner with CS, Finance, Product, Marketing, and Data teams to design scalable processes, implement effective incentives and structures, and ensure execution aligns with business priorities. This is a high-impact role with strong visibility and influence across the organization.


Key Responsibilities:

  • Partner with CS and executive leadership to define the go-to-market strategy—including segmentation, sales motions, and revenue growth priorities.
  • Design and continuously refine quota-setting frameworks, territory models, and headcount planning to enable scalable growth.
  • Develop compensation strategies and incentive structures that drive exceptional performance while aligning with company objectives.
  • Build and manage strategic dashboards and frameworks to monitor CS productivity, NRR, Excel/Google Sheets as needed.
  • Translate business questions into analytical projects, delivering actionable insights to guide product focus, market entry, and commercial efficiency.
  • Drive operational rigor through annual/quarterly planning cycles, cross-functional alignment, and performance reviews.
  • Identify and implement process improvements across tools, data flows, and CRM workflows (HubSpot) to enhance efficiency at scale.


Requirements:

  • 3–4 years of experience in Customer Success Operations or Business Operations, preferably within a SaaS or technology company.
  • Strong proficiency in Excel/Sheets and CRM tools (HubSpot knowledge is a plus)
  • Solid understanding of SaaS metrics and revenue motions (new business, upsell, retention).
  • Excellent communication skills in English (both written and verbal).
  • Proven ability to collaborate cross-functionally and independently lead complex initiatives.
  • Comfortable presenting insights and recommendations to senior leadership.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Economics, Business, or a related field.
  • Advanced spoken and written English skills.


Why Join Us?

  • Opportunity to work in a high-growth SaaS environment with global exposure.
  • Direct impact on go-to-market strategy and revenue growth.
  • Collaborative, data-driven, and entrepreneurial culture.
  • Competitive compensation and benefits package.
  • This is a role based in Brazil, and you’ll collaborate closely with teams across the U.S. and Brazil.


Your work will follow Brasilia Standard Time (BRT), and you’ll be hired as a CLT contract employee with compensation in BRL.

description:

Post Producer

Location: Remote

Position Type: Contract

Company: Pocket FM



About Us

At Pocket FM, our mission is to deliver immersive storytelling experiences to a global audience. With a global audience of over 200 million listeners, we are redefining entertainment through episodic audio storytelling across diverse genres. We are seeking a highly organized and creative Creative Producer to manage and oversee the end-to-end production of high-quality audio content.

Role Overview

As a Creative Producer , you will play a key role in managing the end-to-end production process of audio content across various formats on Pocket FM. You will collaborate closely with writers, voice artists, creators, and production teams to ensure timely delivery of high-quality episodes. The role requires strong operational management, creative oversight, and the ability to coordinate across multiple stakeholders to deliver compelling audio experiences for our listeners.



Key Responsibilities

1. Post Production Operations Management

Oversee day-to-day post-production operations for ongoing audio shows and promotional adds, ensuring smooth workflows from raw audio to final delivery. Manage editing, sound design, mixing, and mastering pipelines to meet release schedules.

2. Post Production Team Coordination

Work closely with editors, sound designers, mixing engineers, and external post-production vendors to deliver high-quality audio content. Ensure clear briefs, efficient collaboration, and consistency across outputs.

3. Production Planning & Pipeline Management

Collaborate with content and production teams to plan post-production schedules, track weekly deliverables, and ensure timely completion of all episodes. Proactively identify and resolve bottlenecks in the pipeline.

4. Stakeholder Collaboration

Coordinate with cross-functional teams including Content, Marketing, Product, and Quality Control to align on timelines, creative requirements, and delivery standards.

5. Audio Quality & Finishing Oversight

Own the final quality of all audio outputs, including editing precision, sound design, mixing balance, mastering levels, and overall listening experience. Ensure all content meets defined technical and creative benchmarks before release.

6. Vendor & Partner Management

Build and manage a network of external studios, freelancers, and post-production partners to support scalable content production. Ensure quality, consistency, and timely delivery across partners.

7. Feedback Integration & Continuous Improvement

Monitor listener feedback and internal QC inputs to identify issues related to audio clarity, pacing, sound design, or technical quality. Drive improvements across post-production processes.

8. Process & Workflow Optimization

Continuously enhance post-production workflows, tools, and standards to improve efficiency, scalability, and output quality. Document best practices, templates, and guidelines for consistent execution.

9. Volume & Deadline Management

Manage high-volume content pipelines across multiple shows, ensuring all deadlines are met without compromising on audio quality or production standards.

10. Quality Control Training & Creative Alignment

Continuously train and support QC team members responsible for assigned shows to ensure strong alignment on creative direction, audio quality standards, storytelling expectations, and technical benchmarks. Work closely with QC specialists on a weekly basis to review content, calibrate feedback, identify recurring issues, and maintain consistency across shows and post-production outputs.


11. Internal Promotional Video Post-Production Leadership

Lead the internal post-production team for promotional video assets, aligning editors, sound designers, and mixers around consistent quality standards, sonic identity, creative style, and delivery expectations. Ensure all promotional videos maintain a cohesive audio language, polished sound design, and production value aligned with brand and marketing objectives.

12. AI-driven Innovations and tool adotion

Leverage AI-powered tools and emerging technologies across editing, sound design, voice processing, mixing, mastering, QC, and workflow automation to improve efficiency, scalability, and creative quality. Stay updated on evolving AI trends in post-production and evaluate new tools/workflows that enhance turnaround time, consistency, audio quality, and overall production effectiveness while maintaining strong creative and editorial standards.



Qualifications

  • 7+ years of experience in post-production, audio production, or media production, with a strong focus on editing, sound design, and final delivery workflows.
  • Solid understanding of audio storytelling and hands-on experience across post-production stages, including editing, mixing, mastering, and finishing for podcasts or audiobooks.
  • Proven experience working with post-production teams such as editors, sound designers, mixing engineers, or external production vendors.
  • Strong project management and organizational skills, with the ability to manage multiple post-production pipelines and deadlines simultaneously.
  • Effective stakeholder management and communication skills, with experience collaborating across content, production, and quality teams.
  • Ability to operate in fast-paced, high-volume production environments while maintaining consistent quality standards.
  • Self-driven with strong problem-solving capabilities and a proactive approach to identifying and resolving production challenges.

We are looking for self-starting engineers who think deeply about system scale, creatively solve problems, and can move forward in high ambiguity.


You’ll join a lean engineering team where your work has a direct, visible impact on the platform and the customers who use it. We have new services to architect, bottlenecks to eliminate, and workflows to redesign from scratch.


Additionally, you’ll support live systems, investigate and resolve bugs, and help keep a platform that customers depend on running smoothly.

  • Architect new systems and contribute to technical direction
  • Improve and automate customer onboarding workflows
  • Identify and resolve performance bottlenecks across the stack
  • Collaborate directly with the team and senior technical leadership

  • Java - core backend services, business logic, API, thick client

  • Java Servlets - HTTP request handling
  • PostgreSQL + Hibernate

What we are looking for

We hire for fundamentals, ownership, and a love of building. Depending on your experience level, here’s what we care about:


Required

  • Deep proficiency in Java with a strong command of the language and ecosystem
  • Proven experience optimizing application performance through JVM heap tuning, garbage collection analysis, and memory allocation strategies
  • Strong computer science fundamentals, including data structures, algorithms, and systems-level thinking
  • Demonstrated experience designing, building, and maintaining REST APIs and backend services

Nice to Have

  • Familiarity with Apache Tomcat in production or staging environments

Why Theta Data

description:

  • Construir e manter pipelines de MLOps para automação de etapas como treino, validação, empacotamento, versionamento, deploy, rollback, monitoramento e retreinamento de modelos.
  • Apoiar a produção de modelos de Machine Learning em ambientes batch, near real-time e real-time, garantindo escalabilidade, resiliência, segurança e observabilidade.

  • Contribuir para a criação de padrões de observabilidade para modelos em produção, incluindo métricas técnicas e de negócio, drift de dados e de modelos, latência, disponibilidade, custo e performance.
  • Atuar em parceria com times de Data Science, Dados, Engenharia, Arquitetura, Segurança e Governança para garantir aderência a padrões corporativos, regulatórios e operacionais.

Requisitos e qualificações


  • Formação superior completa em Ciência da Computação, Engenharia da Computação, Sistemas de Informação, Engenharia de Software, Matemática, Estatística ou áreas correlatas.

  • Conhecimento prático do ciclo de vida de modelos de Machine Learning em produção: desenvolvimento, treino, versionamento, deploy, monitoramento, sustentação e melhoria contínua.
  • Experiência com desenvolvimento em Python, Java e boas práticas de engenharia de software, incluindo testes, versionamento, code review, modularização e documentação técnica.
  • Conhecimento em construção e orquestração de pipelines de dados e/ou ML, utilizando ferramentas como Airflow, Step Functions, Kubeflow, MLflow, Jenkins, GitHub Actions ou equivalentes.
  • Experiência com cloud computing, preferencialmente AWS, incluindo serviços relacionados a processamento, armazenamento, orquestração, APIs, segurança e observabilidade.
  • Conhecimento em containers, APIs, microsserviços e arquitetura distribuída, como Docker, Kubernetes, serviços REST/gRPC ou equivalentes.
  • Experiência com práticas de CI/CD aplicadas a modelos, serviços de inferência ou pipelines analíticos.
  • Conhecimento em bancos de dados, SQL, ambientes analíticos e integração com plataformas de dados.

  • Experiência com monitoramento, logs, métricas, rastreabilidade e troubleshooting de aplicações, pipelines ou modelos em produção.
  • Experiência com plataformas de model registry, feature store, experiment tracking, model serving e model monitoring, utilizando ferramentas como MLflow, SageMaker, Databricks, Feast, Evidently, WhyLabs, BentoML, KServe ou similares.
  • Conhecimento em arquitetura de plataformas internas para Machine Learning, com foco em self-service, padronização e reuso.
  • Experiência com modelos em ambientes de alta escala, alta disponibilidade ou baixa latência.

Para se destacar nesta posição seria legal se você também tivesse:

  • Experiência em ambientes regulados, especialmente mercado financeiro, meios de pagamento, bancos digitais, fintechs, crédito, risco, fraude, adquirência ou CRM.
  • Conhecimento em Kafka, arquiteturas orientadas a eventos e processamento distribuído.
  • Experiência com práticas de segurança em cloud, IAM, secrets management, criptografia, segregação de ambientes e proteção de dados sensíveis.

Role Overview


Syntage is seeking an IT & Automation Manager to serve as the technical owner of our internal systems, IT infrastructure, and process automations. This role bridges the gap between business operations and technology. You will act as an internal consultant outlining high-level technical strategies, while also personally executing the hands-on development—including software integrations, AI adoption, and workflow automations. Additionally, you will manage the company’s foundational cybersecurity posture and day-to-day IT administration.


Key Responsibilities


Business Process Engineering (Core Expectation)

  • Conduct needs assessments with department leads to identify operational bottlenecks and manual processes.
  • Translate non-technical business requirements into actionable architectural designs and technical scopes.
  • Act as an internal consultant, proposing ROI-driven technology implementations.
  • Manage change adoption by providing training, documentation, and ongoing support for newly implemented tools.

Automation, Integration & AI Implementation

  • Design, build, and maintain system integrations across our SaaS ecosystem utilizing REST APIs, webhooks, and middleware platforms (e.g., Zapier, Make, n8n) or custom scripts (Python, JavaScript).
  • Evaluate, test, and deploy AI tools to automate routine operational tasks.
  • Administer databases and ensure data integrity as information flows between the CRM, ERP, and operational software.

IT Administration & Security

  • Administer core software platforms and directories, including (Google Workspace / Microsoft 365).
  • Manage the employee technology lifecycle, including hardware provisioning and onboarding/offboarding technical access.
  • Enforce cybersecurity best practices, managing Identity and Access Management (IAM), SSO, MFA, and endpoint security.
  • Manage IT vendor relationships, negotiate SaaS contracts, and monitor software spend to systematically prevent tool sprawl.


Required Qualifications & Skills


Technical Experience:

  • 5+ years of hybrid experience spanning IT Administration, Systems Architecture, Technical Operations, Business Process Engineering, or Software Integration.
  • Demonstrated experience managing technology projects end-to-end within an SMB or startup environment.
  • Strong understanding of cloud-based SaaS ecosystems, APIs, and relational data structures.
  • High proficiency in building complex workflows using middleware (e.g., n8n, Make, Zapier) or lightweight scripting.
  • Practical knowledge of applying AI tools to everyday business workflows.
  • Foundational understanding of cybersecurity risk management, network security, and data privacy protocols.


Soft Skills & Behavioral Competencies:

  • Communication: Proven ability to effectively translate business needs into technical scopes, and explain complex technical concepts and security requirements to non-technical stakeholders with patience and clarity.
  • Critical Thinking: Strong analytical approach to problem-solving; ability to identify the root causes of operational friction rather than just treating symptoms.
  • Decision-Making: Highly autonomous execution; capable of evaluating vendor tools, technical trade-offs, and ROI to make definitive architectural and software purchasing decisions.


Benefits & Compensation

title: Full Stack Engineer (Pleno) | Node.js + React + PHP

Confira esta oportunidade para Full Stack Engineer (Pleno) | Node.js + React + PHP em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Quem somos?

Somos uma healthtech de Ribeirão Preto (SP) que combate fraudes, desperdícios e inconsistências na saúde por meio da Carefy, uma plataforma de auditoria com inteligência artificial. Nossa missão é construir a infraestrutura de auditoria inteligente para um sistema de saúde mais eficiente, econômico e acessível — algo que já colocamos em prática ao apoiar dezenas de planos de saúde no país, como Hapvida, Porto Seguro Saúde e diversas Unimeds.

Conheça os valores e como a gente trabalha na Carefy:

  • Fazer acontecer: A gente executa, mesmo sem cenário perfeito. 
  • Jogar limpo: Somos transparentes, ética e claros em todas as relações.
  • Desafio move a gente: Aqui, problema difícil não trava, motiva. Buscamos gente curiosa, fuçada e autodirigida, que vai atrás da resposta e faz acontecer.
  • Aprender rápido: Errar faz parte do processo, repetir erro, não. A gente testa, ajusta e evolui com velocidade.
  • Cliente no centro: Se não gera valor real para o cliente, a gente repensa.
  • 2 é maior que 1: Acreditamos em colaboração de verdade, e você não estará sozinho. 
  • Feito é melhor que perfeito: A gente entrega, aprende com o uso e melhora rápido. Aqui não é lugar de burocracia ou preciosismo pela perfeição.

Qual o desafio?

Buscamos uma pessoa para atuar em um momento estratégico da nossa evolução tecnológica. Você terá o desafio duplo de manter e evoluir nossa base atual e, paralelamente, ser uma peça-chave na modernização da nossa arquitetura. Isso envolve a migração ativa de serviços legados para stacks modernas e a implementação de novos padrões de escalabilidade e isolamento de dados.

O que você irá fazer no dia-a-dia?

A missão dessa vaga é desenvolver e melhorar constantemente a nossa plataforma, garantindo a transição fluida entre tecnologias e mantendo a alta disponibilidade para nossos clientes.

  • Desenvolvimento e Sustentação : Atuar na manutenção e evolução de sistemas existentes em PHP (CodeIgniter), garantindo estabilidade e performance.
  • Modernização e Migração : Desenvolver novos serviços, APIs e microsserviços utilizando Node.js (JavaScript/TypeScript), apoiando ativamente a migração do nosso legado.
  • Arquitetura e Banco de Dados : Participar da modelagem e otimização de bancos de dados relacionais (MySQL).
  • Frontend : Criar e dar manutenção em interfaces responsivas e dinâmicas utilizando HTML, CSS, JavaScript (Vanilla e frameworks modernos).
  • Qualidade e Segurança : Escrever código limpo, realizar code reviews, implementar testes (unitários e de integração) e aplicar boas práticas de segurança.
  • Cloud e DevOps : Apoiar nas esteiras de CI/CD e interagir com infraestrutura em nuvem (GCP) com foco em eficiência e redução de custos.

O que esperamos de você?

Pra gente, o que realmente importa é ter match com a nossa cultura, mas, para essa vaga, temos algumas características que consideramos essenciais:

  • Trabalho em equipe: Colaborar de forma transparente com outros desenvolvedores, arquitetos e liderança técnica.
  • Flexibilidade e Adaptação: Transitar confortavelmente entre o legado (PHP) e a nova stack (Node.js), entendendo o valor de ambos para o negócio.
  • Resolução de Problemas: Foco na causa raiz, trazendo soluções criativas tanto em código quanto em arquitetura.
  • Gestão de tempo e Autonomia: Organizar suas entregas com qualidade, cumprindo prazos e destravando impedimentos de forma proativa.

Quais são os requisitos?

  • Experiência de 3+ anos em desenvolvimento de software;
  • Experiência de 2+ anos com Node.js e TypeScript em produção 
  • Experiência de 1+ anos com PHP em produção;
  • Experiência de 2+ anos com Tecnologias Web em produção;
  • Experiência de 2+ anos com Bancos de Dados Relacionais (MySQL) , incluindo modelagem;
  • Experiência com filas e mensageria (RabbitMQ);
  • Conhecimento de frameworks modernos como NestJS e/ou Next.js;
  • Conhecimento em padrões de arquitetura (Clean Architecture, SOLID);
  • Conhecimento sólido em Git e versionamento de código;
  • Vivência com metodologias ágeis (Scrum/Kanban);
  • Habilidade para trabalhar de forma colaborativa.

Será um diferencial:

  • Experiência em migração de sistemas monolíticos/legados para microsserviços;
  • Experiência na sustentação de aplicações escaláveis utilizando Kubernetes e Terraform;
  • Familiaridade com pipelines de CI/CD (Bitbucket Pipelines, GitHub Actions, Jenkins, etc.);
  • Conhecimentos em Segurança da Informação (OWASP, OAuth2);
  • Conhecimento prático na integração de LLMs (OpenAI, Gemini, etc.) e no desenvolvimento de fluxos utilizando AI Agents.

O que oferecemos?

  • Modalidade Flexível: Híbrido (para residentes em Ribeirão Preto e região) ou 100% Remoto (para candidatos de outras localidades);
  • Possibilidade de regime CLT ou PJ;
  • 6 dias de folga anuais + folga de aniversário;
  • Bônus de indicação;
  • Bônus de equipe;
  • Se CLT, convênio com Bradesco Saúde e Cartão Flash (VA e VR);
  • Ambiente colaborativo e desafiador;
  • Horários flexíveis;
  • Autonomia para propor e implementar novas tecnologias!

Faça parte da nossa revolução na saúde!

title: Médico Gastroenterologista
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Médico Gastroenterologista em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

*OPORTUNIDADE PARA MÉDICO GASTROENTEROLOGISTA NA TELADOC HEALTH\"


Junte-se à Nossa Equipe de Saúde Digital!


A Teladoc Health, líder global em saúde digital e inovação em cuidados de saúde, está buscando Médicos e Médicas Especialistas em Gastroenterologia! Se você é um profissional comprometido com a excelência no atendimento ao paciente e deseja fazer parte de uma revolução na prestação de serviços de saúde, esta é a oportunidade que você estava esperando.


*SOBRE A TELADOC HEALTH: *

A Teladoc Health está na vanguarda da transformação da saúde, oferecendo acesso rápido, conveniente e confiável a serviços de saúde através de nossa plataforma digital. Nossa missão é tornar o cuidado de saúde acessível a todos, em qualquer lugar e a qualquer momento. Combinando tecnologia de ponta e conhecimento médico, estamos moldando o futuro da saúde e proporcionando impacto positivo na vida de milhões de pessoas.


*O QUE PROCURAMOS: *


Você será responsável por realizar consultas por vídeo e telefone, por intermédio de plataforma do empregador, atendendo na especialidade de Gastroenterologia , de forma ética, com abordagem biopsicossocial do processo saúde-adoecimento, integrando ações de prevenção, promoção, proteção, recuperação e educação em saúde buscando alcançar os melhores resultados clínicos;


PAPEIS E RESPONSABILIDADES


  • Fornecer atendimento médico especializado em gastroenterologia de forma remota, através de consultas e avaliações realizadas por meio de plataformas digitais de comunicação.


  • Experiência e conhecimento para o diagnóstico, tratamento e acompanhamento de pacientes com doenças e distúrbios gastrointestinais.


  • Realizar consultas em Telemedicina sendo capaz de: conduzir anamneses virtuais para coletar queixas e histórico médico, realizar exame clínico e avaliações do sistema gastrointestinal à distância, interpretar resultados de exames laboratoriais, endoscópicos e de imagem, elaborar diagnósticos precisos, propor medidas terapêuticas e orientações de cuidado, reconhecer sinais de gravidade em gastroenterologia e critérios para encaminhar ao atendimento presencial.


  • Atuar de forma a priorizar a prática médica centrada na pessoa.


  • Elaborar planos de tratamento individualizados, levando em consideração as necessidades específicas de cada paciente.


  • Ser hábil na prescrição de medicamentos adequados para tratar doenças gastrointestinais.


  • Recomendar alterações no estilo de vida, dieta e hábitos alimentares para melhorar a saúde digestiva.


  • Monitorar o progresso dos pacientes ao longo do tratamento em telemedicina.


  • Realizar ajustes no plano de tratamento, conforme necessário, com base na resposta do paciente ao tratamento.


  • Desenvolver atividades integrais de saúde, incorporando prevenção e promoção de saúde para dar as respostas mais adequadas às necessidades de saúde apresentadas.


  • Atender com elevado grau de qualidade, sendo resolutivo na grande maioria das orientações acerca de problemas de saúde gastrointestinais.


  • Considerar os valores e preferências pessoais do paciente conjuntamente às melhores evidências científicas e à experiência de manejo clínico para efetivamente promover a melhor prática clínica e os melhores desfechos em saúde para cada indivíduo.


  • Exercer uso racional de recursos em saúde visando a segurança do paciente e a prevenção quaternária, evitando sobrediagnóstico e sobretratamento, que expõe os indivíduos a maiores riscos do que benefícios em saúde.


  • Estimular a participação e a autonomia dos indivíduos e familiares, fortalecendo a aderência a tratamentos e medidas de autocuidado.


  • Documentar todas as interações e informações relevantes dos pacientes em prontuários eletrônicos seguros e confidenciais.


  • Ter capacidade de crítica de sua própria atividade médica, considerando-a em seus aspectos científicos, éticos e sociais para aprimoramento contínuo.


  • Manter-se bem-informado e atualizado, ampliando sua própria competência em relação a conhecimentos sobre riscos em saúde e sobre as medidas mais eficientes para eliminar ou reduzir os riscos relevantes.


  • Respeitar, cumprir e fazer cumprir os ditames do Código de Ética Médica, bem como a Legislação vigente e os regulamentos internos formais da Instituição.



REQUISITOS


Formação Acadêmica:

  • Obrigatório: GRADUAÇÃO EM MEDICINA
  • RESIDÊNCIA MÉDICA CONCLUÍDA (ou em andamento) OU ESPECIALIZAÇÃO/PÓS EM GASTROENTEROLOGIA (CLÍNICA OU CIRÚRGICA).


Certificações:

  • Registro ativo no Conselho Regional de Medicina (CRM);
  • Certificado de Título de Especialista em Gastroenterologia - RQE (Emitido pelo Conselho); ou comprovante de matrícula em Residência médica. Pós ou Especialização na área;
  • Certificado Digital Ativo reconhecido pela Infraestrutura de Chaves Públicas Brasileira (ICP-Brasil);


Experiência:

  • Experiência em atividades relacionadas à atuação em atendimento médico em gastroenterologia, sendo desejável experiência prévia em Telemedicina e Atenção Primária à Saúde;
  • Experiência em atividades relacionadas à atuação em atendimento médico na Atenção Primária à Saúde;


Conhecimentos Específicos para a função:

Prestar orientações personalizadas a indivíduos e suas famílias com conhecimentos para o diagnóstico, tratamento e acompanhamento de pacientes com doenças e distúrbios gastrointestinais.


Competências Comportamentais:

Comprometimento com os pacientes, com ideais e valores da empresa, apresentando postura ética, pontualidade, capacidade de integração com equipe multiprofissional.


Outros Requisitos Importantes:

Conhecimentos e Habilidades em computação: uso do Pacote Office (Excel, Word, Power Point, Gráficos) e Internet. Familiaridade com tecnologias de telemedicina e uso de plataformas de comunicação virtual é um diferencial desejável.


Local de Trabalho:

REMOTO


Remuneração e Agendamentos: a combinar durante processo seletivo.



IMPORTANTE:

MODELO DE CONTRATAÇÃO: Contratação em regime de Prestador de Serviços por contrato Pessoa Jurídica, necessário fazer parte como representante legal ou sócio de um CNPJ ativo, bem como possuir CRM do respectivo CNPJ ativo.


Esta descrição de cargo/atuação tem caráter informativo e pode ser ajustada conforme a necessidade da empresa ou instituição que oferece a oportunidade de trabalho em telemedicina para Médico Clínico/Generalista Residente em Gastroenterologista.

title: Fund Operations Analyst
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Fund Operations Analyst em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar. The Role
We're looking for a highly organized, detail-oriented Fund Operations Analyst with 1 to 3 years of experience to join our team in São Paulo. This is a critical role in our firm's infrastructure, demanding both technical rigor and strong operational ownership.
You will be a key member of our back-office team, working directly with the CFO and senior partners to ensure the efficiency, compliance, and scalability of our fund's operations. You will own the \"engine room\" of an international investment fund — managing offshore structures, investor relations, financial controls, and regulatory compliance across multiple jurisdictions.
This role offers significant exposure to the full lifecycle of a growth-stage VC fund and direct interaction with world-class financial service providers.
Key Responsibilities
· Financial Management & Treasury — Own day-to-day treasury operations for both local (CNPJs) and offshore entities, including accounts payable/receivable, cash flow management, FX operations, and bank reconciliations.
· Fund Administration Management — Manage the relationship with external stakeholders of the fund's US entities, including Fund Administrators, legal counsel, tax advisors, and external auditors (Big 4).
· Investor Relations (IR) Operations — Execute Capital Calls, Distributions, and NAV calculations. Lead LP onboarding (KYC/AML) and serve as the primary point of contact for investor inquiries and reporting.
· Financial Reporting & Close — Lead monthly and quarterly close in coordination with external accountants. Review the fund's financial statements for accuracy and compliance (US GAAP / IFRS).
· Legal & Governance — Review fund documents (agreements, side letters, subscription docs) and maintain the Data Room to ensure audit readiness at all times.
· Fundraising Operations Support — Support capital raising processes, including Data Room management, LP due diligence coordination, and subscription document processing.
· Process Improvement — Continuously identify opportunities to improve operational efficiency and implement scalable processes and tools across the fund's back-office.
Requirements
· 1–3 years of experience in Fund Operations, Fund Administration, Audit (Big 4 or similar), or Corporate Finance / Treasury at a financial institution, investment fund, or large corporation.
· Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Business Administration, Economics, or a related field.
· Exceptional organizational skills and precision in financial data management.
· Advanced proficiency in Excel.
· Ability to interpret financial statements, understand fund accounting principles, and flag risks proactively.
· Ownership mentality — ability to manage multiple workflows autonomously and communicate effectively with senior stakeholders.
· Fluent English

title: Pessoa Engenheira de Dados- IA
description:

Esta função é estratégica para nossas soluções de marketing orientadas a dados. Buscamos alguém que combine domínio técnico em engenharia de dados com afinidade real por inteligência artificial e experiência prática com Databricks.

  • Experiência prática na arquitetura de microsserviços e desenvolvimento/consumo de APIs REST e SOAP (JSON, autenticação e integração).
  • Perfil de liderança técnica com excelente capacidade de comunicação, colaboração e mentoria.


Diferenciais:

  • Conhecimentos práticos e noções em nuvem AWS (infraestrutura básica, serviços de cloud e deploy).
  • Experiência na configuração e otimização de pipelines de CI/CD e gerenciamento de API Gateways.


Informações adicionais:

  • Modelo de contrato CLT


Se você estiver pronto para levar sua carreira de desenvolvimento de software para o próximo nível, adoraríamos conhecê-lo!

title: Creative Producer
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Creative Producer em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

VOA Creative Producer

Location: Remote

Position Type: Contract

Company: Pocket FM



About Us

At Pocket FM, our mission is to deliver immersive storytelling experiences to a global audience. With a global audience of over 200 million listeners, we are redefining entertainment through episodic audio storytelling across diverse genres. We are seeking a highly organized and creative Creative Producer to manage and oversee the end-to-end production of high-quality audio content.

Role Overview

As a Creative Producer , you will play a key role in managing the end-to-end production process of audio content across various formats on Pocket FM. You will collaborate closely with writers, voice artists, creators, and production teams to ensure timely delivery of high-quality episodes. The role requires strong operational management, creative oversight, and the ability to coordinate across multiple stakeholders to deliver compelling audio experiences for our listeners.



Key Responsibilities

1. Content Operations Management

Ensure smooth daily operations of running audio shows and manage the production pipeline to deliver episodes as per planned schedules.

2. Creator & Talent Coordination

Work closely with voice-over artists, creators, writers, and dubbing artists (both internal and external) to produce engaging audio content.

3. Production Planning

Collaborate with content and production teams to plan episode pipelines, track weekly deliverables, and ensure timely completion of projects.

4. Stakeholder Collaboration

Coordinate with cross-functional teams including Content, Marketing, Product, and Quality teams to ensure alignment on production goals and timelines.

5. Production Quality Oversight

Work closely with the QC team to maintain high production standards, ensuring the final content meets quality benchmarks before launch.

6. Creator Network Management

Build and manage a network of internal and external creators and production partners to support large-scale content creation.

7. Audience Feedback Monitoring

Track user feedback and listener comments to identify potential issues related to voice quality, narration, or sound production and coordinate with relevant teams for improvements.

8. Process & Workflow Optimization

Identify opportunities to improve production workflows, creator management processes, and operational efficiency across projects.

9. Volume & Deadline Management

Manage multiple projects simultaneously while ensuring deadlines are met and quality standards are maintained.



Qualifications

  • 3+ years of experience in content production, creator management, or media production.
  • Strong understanding of audio storytelling, podcast production, or audiobook production workflows .
  • Proven experience working with creators, voice artists, or creative production teams.
  • Excellent project management and organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple workstreams.
  • Strong stakeholder management and communication skills.
  • Ability to work in fast-paced environments and handle high-volume content production.
  • Self-motivated with strong problem-solving abilities and a proactive mindset.

title: Landing Page Designer, Conversion Focused
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Landing Page Designer, Conversion Focused em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Are you looking for an opportunity to make an incredible impact in the world of socially conscious brands?


Lucyd Media is a social advertising agency, specializing in the compliant advertising for CBD, Cannabis, and other DTC wellness e-commerce brands. Our mission is to reduce human suffering and maximize human potential by facilitating the distribution of Conscious Compounds™


We are currently seeking a strong landing page (LP) designer to lead the design and optimization of the post-click experience across our paid media funnels.


At Lucyd, we believe the post-click experience is one of the biggest underutilized levers in wellness growth. We need someone who can bring real authority to that part of the funnel, move quickly, use AI aggressively, and help us create a more seamless conversion experience across the brands we serve. This role will use AI-assisted tools to rapidly generate and iterate on landing pages, while applying strong design judgment and conversion strategy.


Ready to elevate your career? We're excited to hear from you.


What You Will Be Responsible For:

  • Designing and optimizing landing pages, offer pages, and funnel-specific product pages
  • Translating ad hooks and offer strategy into conversion-focused page experiences
  • Improving what users land on after the click, whether that is a custom landing page, PDP variant, or other post-click experience
  • Supporting page testing, iteration, and optimization based on performance
  • Identifying where the current post-click experience is creating friction or hurting conversion
  • Helping define how landing pages should be requested, built, and improved within Lucyd
  • Using AI tools to speed up production and increase design leverage
  • Partnering closely with Growth Strategists, Advertising, and Post-Click teams


What We Are Looking For:

  • 3+ years of experience in CRO-focused design, landing page design, funnel design, or conversion-oriented eCommerce design.
  • A portfolio demonstrating at least 20 DTC/eCommerce landing pages or product pages (PDPs) you have designed. Candidates without relevant portfolio examples will not be considered.
  • Experience designing for paid media funnels, not just general web design. You know how to align page structure and messaging to the promise made in the ad.
  • Comfort using AI tools to generate and iterate on landing page designs quickly, while applying strong design judgment and strategic direction. You know how to use tools to move faster while still applying judgment and taste.
  • Exceptional organizational skills, adept at juggling multiple projects while maintaining top-notch productivity and prioritization.
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills to manage client expectations and maintain strong relationships.
  • Experience in DTC wellness supplements, cannabis or other restricted products or adjacent consumer categories is a plus


Success Roadmap:


In 30 Days, You'll:

  • Audit the current pages users land on after the click, including landing pages, PDPs, collections, and offer pages.
  • Identify the highest-priority opportunities to improve conversion through better post-click experiences.
  • Begin improving the process for how landing pages are requested, built, and reviewed.
  • Design and launch your first new landing pages for active client accounts.

In 60 Days, You'll:

  • Partner closely with Growth Strategists to align page structure with ad hooks, offers, and buyer intent.
  • Start identifying patterns in what is driving or hurting conversion across pages.
  • Own the design and optimization of post-click experiences for multiple active accounts.
  • Contribute to a faster, more repeatable landing page production process

In 90 Days, You'll:

  • Be the clear internal owner of conversion-focused post-click design
  • Establish a more seamless system for building, iterating, and optimizing landing pages.
  • Consistently use AI tools to increase speed, output, and design leverage.
  • Provide strong guidance to the team on what users should land on after they click on an ad.


By Your One-Year Anniversary:

You will have helped establish Lucyd’s post-click experience as a meaningful performance lever across paid media. You will have contributed to:

  • Faster landing page creation and iteration
  • Higher-quality post-click experiences
  • Better alignment between ads, offers, and page structure
  • A more intentional system for designing and optimizing pages users land on after the click


Apply now to become an integral part of our mission to connect socially conscious brands with their audiences in meaningful ways.

title: Landing Page Designer, Conversion Focused
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Landing Page Designer, Conversion Focused em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Are you looking for an opportunity to make an incredible impact in the world of socially conscious brands?


Lucyd Media is a social advertising agency, specializing in the compliant advertising for CBD, Cannabis, and other DTC wellness e-commerce brands. Our mission is to reduce human suffering and maximize human potential by facilitating the distribution of Conscious Compounds™


We are currently seeking a strong landing page (LP) designer to lead the design and optimization of the post-click experience across our paid media funnels.


At Lucyd, we believe the post-click experience is one of the biggest underutilized levers in wellness growth. We need someone who can bring real authority to that part of the funnel, move quickly, use AI aggressively, and help us create a more seamless conversion experience across the brands we serve. This role will use AI-assisted tools to rapidly generate and iterate on landing pages, while applying strong design judgment and conversion strategy.


Ready to elevate your career? We're excited to hear from you.


What You Will Be Responsible For:

  • Designing and optimizing landing pages, offer pages, and funnel-specific product pages
  • Translating ad hooks and offer strategy into conversion-focused page experiences
  • Improving what users land on after the click, whether that is a custom landing page, PDP variant, or other post-click experience
  • Supporting page testing, iteration, and optimization based on performance
  • Identifying where the current post-click experience is creating friction or hurting conversion
  • Helping define how landing pages should be requested, built, and improved within Lucyd
  • Using AI tools to speed up production and increase design leverage
  • Partnering closely with Growth Strategists, Advertising, and Post-Click teams


What We Are Looking For:

  • 3+ years of experience in CRO-focused design, landing page design, funnel design, or conversion-oriented eCommerce design.
  • A portfolio demonstrating at least 20 DTC/eCommerce landing pages or product pages (PDPs) you have designed. Candidates without relevant portfolio examples will not be considered.
  • Experience designing for paid media funnels, not just general web design. You know how to align page structure and messaging to the promise made in the ad.
  • Comfort using AI tools to generate and iterate on landing page designs quickly, while applying strong design judgment and strategic direction. You know how to use tools to move faster while still applying judgment and taste.
  • Exceptional organizational skills, adept at juggling multiple projects while maintaining top-notch productivity and prioritization.
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills to manage client expectations and maintain strong relationships.
  • Experience in DTC wellness supplements, cannabis or other restricted products or adjacent consumer categories is a plus


Success Roadmap:


In 30 Days, You'll:

  • Audit the current pages users land on after the click, including landing pages, PDPs, collections, and offer pages.
  • Identify the highest-priority opportunities to improve conversion through better post-click experiences.
  • Begin improving the process for how landing pages are requested, built, and reviewed.
  • Design and launch your first new landing pages for active client accounts.

In 60 Days, You'll:

  • Partner closely with Growth Strategists to align page structure with ad hooks, offers, and buyer intent.
  • Start identifying patterns in what is driving or hurting conversion across pages.
  • Own the design and optimization of post-click experiences for multiple active accounts.
  • Contribute to a faster, more repeatable landing page production process

In 90 Days, You'll:

  • Be the clear internal owner of conversion-focused post-click design
  • Establish a more seamless system for building, iterating, and optimizing landing pages.
  • Consistently use AI tools to increase speed, output, and design leverage.
  • Provide strong guidance to the team on what users should land on after they click on an ad.


By Your One-Year Anniversary:

You will have helped establish Lucyd’s post-click experience as a meaningful performance lever across paid media. You will have contributed to:

  • Faster landing page creation and iteration
  • Higher-quality post-click experiences
  • Better alignment between ads, offers, and page structure
  • A more intentional system for designing and optimizing pages users land on after the click


Apply now to become an integral part of our mission to connect socially conscious brands with their audiences in meaningful ways.

title: Back End Developer
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Back End Developer em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

About the Role

StaffingAbroad is seeking a Senior Backend Engineer/ Senior Software Engineer to join a #1 US-based FinTech & Crypto company . This role is ideal for a highly skilled backend developer who excels in C#/.NET and has a strong focus on writing maintainable, scalable, and secure code . You will play a key role in shaping architecture, ensuring system performance, and embedding best practices while working in a fast-paced and innovative environment.

This is a 100% remote, full-time role Salary $5.000USD to $6.000 USD

English C1 required


What You Will Do

  • Develop and Maintain Applications : Build, enhance, and maintain secure, scalable backend services using C#/.NET and integrate with APIs like Plaid, Dwolla, and Treasury Prime.
  • Shape System Architecture : Contribute to system design, ensuring performance, scalability, and security across FinTech applications.
  • Write Quality Code : Implement and test maintainable, well-documented code, with a focus on automation and software best practices.
  • Support Production Systems : Monitor and troubleshoot production applications to ensure high availability and quick issue resolution.
  • Collaborate Across Teams : Work closely with front-end, QA, product, and IT teams, while mentoring junior engineers.
  • Focus on Security and Compliance : Embed security best practices and maintain compliance with FinTech regulations.


What You Will Need

  • Strong Technical Expertise :
  • Solid foundation in design patterns, software development best practices, and principles like SOLID and Clean Code.
  • Proficiency in C#/.NET, ASP.NET MVC/WebAPI, and Object-Relational Mappers (ORMs).
  • Strong understanding of MSSQL database design and optimization.
  • Familiarity with asynchronous microservices architecture and distributed systems.
  • Experience with modern front-end and server-side technologies such as Node.js and React.
  • Commitment to Software Quality :
  • Hands-on experience with unit testing, mocking, integration testing, and ensuring code coverage.
  • Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines, particularly in Azure DevOps.
  • Proficient in version control systems, especially Git.
  • Experience and Education :
  • 6+ years of back-end software development experience.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or a related field (preferred).
  • Collaboration and Communication :
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • Ability to work effectively with team members and stakeholders.
  • Enthusiasm for contributing to a collaborative, dynamic team environment.
  • Cultural Fit :
  • Passion for innovation, accountability, and teamwork.
  • Alignment with a culture that prioritizes excellence in FinTech and Crypto solutions.


Plusses Include

  • Experience with iDesign architecture methodology .
  • Familiarity with cloud platforms such as Azure, including their tools and services.

title: Professor de inglês online
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Professor de inglês online em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

A DevSpeak Academy é uma escola especializada no ensino de inglês para profissionais da área de tecnologia. Nosso foco é preparar alunos para se comunicarem com confiança no mercado internacional, em turmas pequenas e com aulas totalmente online.

Estamos em busca de professores(as) de inglês para integrar nosso time! Procuramos profissionais engajados, comunicativos e que saibam se conectar com adultos que trabalham em TI, trazendo para as aulas situações práticas e relevantes para o dia a dia desses alunos.


Responsabilidades

  • Preparar e ministrar aulas online para adultos, focando em fluência e comunicação em contextos profissionais.
  • Personalizar o conteúdo conforme as necessidades dos alunos, com foco em temas ligados à área de tecnologia.
  • Preencher e manter atualizadas as planilhas de presença e conteúdos ministrados.
  • Disponibilizar semanalmente os materiais e gravações no Google Classroom, seguindo a metodologia da escola.
  • Incentivar a participação e engajamento dos alunos, criando um ambiente colaborativo e motivador.
  • Participar de treinamentos e reuniões pedagógicas para melhoria contínua.


Requisitos

  • Inglês avançado ou fluente.
  • Experiência como professor(a) de inglês.
  • Disponibilidade no período da noite (18h–22h), duas vezes por semana (segunda/quarta ou terça/quinta).
  • Perfil comunicativo e afinidade para trabalhar com profissionais da área de TI.
  • Organização e comprometimento com prazos.
  • Possuir computador para ministrar as aulas.


Diferenciais (não obrigatórios)

  • Disponibilidade no período da manhã (7h-9h), duas vezes por semana (segunda/quarta ou terça/quinta).
  • Conhecimento em Google Meet e Google Classroom.
  • Experiência com ensino para profissionais de TI.
  • Certificações em ensino de inglês (TEFL, CELTA ou equivalentes).


Contratação

  • Regime PJ .
  • Horários fixos (aulas no início da manhã e/ou à noite), com flexibilidade para conciliar com a disponibilidade do professor.
  • Turmas pequenas, que permitem um acompanhamento próximo e personalizado.


Se você tem paixão por ensinar e quer fazer parte de uma escola que conecta inglês e tecnologia, envie seu CV.
